name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.affine_zero_set
statement:
theorem affine_zero_set {d : ℕ} (α β : Fin d → K) (x y : K) :
    (firstEquation α).evalEval x y = 0 ∧ (secondEquation β).evalEval x y = 0 ↔
      (∃ i, x = α i) ∧ (∃ j, y = β j)

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.coordinatePolynomial_eval
statement:
@[simp] theorem coordinatePolynomial_eval {d : ℕ} (α : Fin d → K) (i : Fin d) :
    (coordinatePolynomial α).eval (α i) = 0

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.coordinatePolynomial_eval_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem coordinatePolynomial_eval_eq_zero_iff {d : ℕ} (α : Fin d → K) (x : K) :
    (coordinatePolynomial α).eval x = 0 ↔ ∃ i, x = α i

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.coordinatePolynomial_monic
statement:
theorem coordinatePolynomial_monic {d : ℕ} (α : Fin d → K) :
    (coordinatePolynomial α).Monic

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.coordinatePolynomial_natDegree
statement:
@[simp] theorem coordinatePolynomial_natDegree {d : ℕ} (α : Fin d → K) :
    (coordinatePolynomial α).natDegree = d

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.grid_equations_independent
statement:
theorem grid_equations_independent {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (α β : Fin d → K)
    {a b : K} (h : a • firstEquation α + b • secondEquation β = 0) :
    a = 0 ∧ b = 0

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.grid_injective
statement:
theorem grid_injective {m n : ℕ} (α : Fin m → K) (β : Fin n → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β) :
    Function.Injective (fun ij : Fin m × Fin n => (α ij.1, β ij.2))

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.affineGridEvaluation_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem affineGridEvaluation_apply (α : Fin m → K) (β : Fin n → K)
    (P : K[X][Y]) (ij : Fin m × Fin n) :
    affineGridEvaluation α β P ij = P.evalEval (α ij.1) (β ij.2)

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.affineGridEvaluation_ker
statement:
theorem affineGridEvaluation_ker (α : Fin m → K) (β : Fin n → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β) :
    RingHom.ker (affineGridEvaluation α β) = affineGridIdeal α β

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.affineGridEvaluation_surjective
statement:
theorem affineGridEvaluation_surjective (α : Fin m → K) (β : Fin n → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β) :
    Function.Surjective (affineGridEvaluation α β)

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.affineGridIdeal_le_evaluation_ker
statement:
theorem affineGridIdeal_le_evaluation_ker (α : Fin m → K) (β : Fin n → K) :
    affineGridIdeal α β ≤ RingHom.ker (affineGridEvaluation α β)

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.affineGridQuotient_finite
statement:
theorem affineGridQuotient_finite (α : Fin m → K) (β : Fin n → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β) :
    Module.Finite K (K[X][Y] ⧸ affineGridIdeal α β)

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.affineGridQuotient_finrank
statement:
theorem affineGridQuotient_finrank (α : Fin m → K) (β : Fin n → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β) :
    Module.finrank K (K[X][Y] ⧸ affineGridIdeal α β) = m * n

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.affineGridQuotient_reduced
statement:
theorem affineGridQuotient_reduced (α : Fin m → K) (β : Fin n → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β) :
    IsReduced (K[X][Y] ⧸ affineGridIdeal α β)

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.coordinatePolynomial_dvd_of_eval_zero
statement:
theorem coordinatePolynomial_dvd_of_eval_zero (α : Fin m → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (P : K[X]) (hP : ∀ i, P.eval (α i) = 0) :
    coordinatePolynomial α ∣ P

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.equivMvPolynomial_firstEquation
statement:
@[simp] theorem equivMvPolynomial_firstEquation (α : Fin m → K) :
    Bivariate.equivMvPolynomial K (firstEquation α) = affineFirstProduct α

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.equivMvPolynomial_map_affineGridIdeal
statement:
theorem equivMvPolynomial_map_affineGridIdeal (α : Fin m → K) (β : Fin n → K) :
    (affineGridIdeal α β).map (Bivariate.equivMvPolynomial K).toRingHom =
      mvAffineGridIdeal α β

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.equivMvPolynomial_secondEquation
statement:
@[simp] theorem equivMvPolynomial_secondEquation (β : Fin n → K) :
    Bivariate.equivMvPolynomial K (secondEquation β) = affineSecondProduct β

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.mvAffineGridEvaluation_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem mvAffineGridEvaluation_apply (α : Fin m → K) (β : Fin n → K)
    (P : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K) (ij : Fin m × Fin n) :
    mvAffineGridEvaluation α β P ij =
      MvPolynomial.eval ![α ij.1, β ij.2] P

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.mvAffineGridEvaluation_ker
statement:
theorem mvAffineGridEvaluation_ker (α : Fin m → K) (β : Fin n → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β) :
    RingHom.ker (mvAffineGridEvaluation α β) = mvAffineGridIdeal α β

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.mvAffineGridEvaluation_surjective
statement:
theorem mvAffineGridEvaluation_surjective (α : Fin m → K) (β : Fin n → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β) :
    Function.Surjective (mvAffineGridEvaluation α β)

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.mvAffineGridQuotient_finite
statement:
theorem mvAffineGridQuotient_finite (α : Fin m → K) (β : Fin n → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β) :
    Module.Finite K (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K ⧸ mvAffineGridIdeal α β)

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.mvAffineGridQuotient_finrank
statement:
theorem mvAffineGridQuotient_finrank (α : Fin m → K) (β : Fin n → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β) :
    Module.finrank K (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K ⧸ mvAffineGridIdeal α β) = m * n

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.quotient_reduced_of_affineGridIdeal_le
statement:
theorem quotient_reduced_of_affineGridIdeal_le (α : Fin m → K) (β : Fin n → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β)
    (I : Ideal K[X][Y]) (hI : affineGridIdeal α β ≤ I) : IsReduced (K[X][Y] ⧸ I)

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.quotient_reduced_of_mvAffineGridIdeal_le
statement:
theorem quotient_reduced_of_mvAffineGridIdeal_le (α : Fin m → K) (β : Fin n → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β)
    (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K)) (hI : mvAffineGridIdeal α β ≤ I) :
    IsReduced (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K ⧸ I)

name: ChoppedPlane.isRadical_of_surjective_pi_kernel_le
statement:
theorem isRadical_of_surjective_pi_kernel_le (e : R →+* (ι → K))
    (he : Function.Surjective e) (I : Ideal R) (hker : RingHom.ker e ≤ I) :
    I.IsRadical

name: ChoppedPlane.mem_ideal_iff_vanish_on_selected
statement:
theorem mem_ideal_iff_vanish_on_selected (e : R →+* (ι → K))
    (he : Function.Surjective e) (I : Ideal R) (hker : RingHom.ker e ≤ I)
    (S : Set ι) (hvan : ∀ g ∈ I, ∀ x ∈ S, e g x = 0)
    (hsep : ∀ x, x ∉ S → ∃ g ∈ I, e g x ≠ 0) (f : R) :
    f ∈ I ↔ ∀ x ∈ S, e f x = 0

name: ChoppedPlane.mem_ideal_of_vanish_on_selected
statement:
theorem mem_ideal_of_vanish_on_selected (e : R →+* (ι → K))
    (he : Function.Surjective e) (I : Ideal R) (hker : RingHom.ker e ≤ I)
    (S : Set ι) (hsep : ∀ x, x ∉ S → ∃ g ∈ I, e g x ≠ 0)
    (f : R) (hf : ∀ x ∈ S, e f x = 0) : f ∈ I

name: ChoppedPlane.quotient_reduced_of_surjective_pi_kernel_le
statement:
theorem quotient_reduced_of_surjective_pi_kernel_le (e : R →+* (ι → K))
    (he : Function.Surjective e) (I : Ideal R) (hker : RingHom.ker e ≤ I) :
    IsReduced (R ⧸ I)

name: ChoppedPlane.evaluationLinear_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem evaluationLinear_apply (x : Fin n → K) (f : Forms K n d) :
    evaluationLinear K n d x f = MvPolynomial.eval x f.val

name: ChoppedPlane.finrank_forms
statement: theorem finrank_forms : finrank K (Forms K n d) = (n + d - 1).choose d

name: ChoppedPlane.finrank_plane_forms
statement: theorem finrank_plane_forms : finrank K (Forms K 3 d) = (d + 2).choose 2

name: ChoppedPlane.formsBasis_map
statement:
theorem formsBasis_map {L : Type*} [Field L] (k : K →+* L) (i : Sym (Fin n) d) :
    MvPolynomial.map k (formsBasis K n d i).val = (formsBasis L n d i).val

name: ChoppedPlane.formsBasis_val_monomial
statement:
theorem formsBasis_val_monomial (i : Sym (Fin n) d) :
    (formsBasis K n d i).val = monomial (exponentEquiv n d i).val 1

name: ChoppedPlane.forms_mul_forms
statement: theorem forms_mul_forms : Forms K n d * Forms K n e = Forms K n (d + e)

name: ChoppedPlane.homogeneous_eval_scale
statement:
theorem homogeneous_eval_scale {σ R : Type*} [CommSemiring R]
    {f : MvPolynomial σ R} {d : ℕ} (hf : f.IsHomogeneous d)
    (x : σ → R) (a : R) :
    MvPolynomial.eval (fun i => a * x i) f = a ^ d * MvPolynomial.eval x f

name: ChoppedPlane.homogeneous_eval_scale_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem homogeneous_eval_scale_eq_zero_iff {σ R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    [IsDomain R] {f : MvPolynomial σ R} {d : ℕ}
    (hf : f.IsHomogeneous d) (x : σ → R) {a : R} (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    MvPolynomial.eval (fun i => a * x i) f = 0 ↔ MvPolynomial.eval x f = 0

name: ChoppedPlane.homogeneous_eval₂_scale
statement:
theorem homogeneous_eval₂_scale {σ R T : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [CommSemiring T]
    {f : MvPolynomial σ R} {d : ℕ} (hf : f.IsHomogeneous d)
    (k : R →+* T) (x : σ → T) (a : T) :
    MvPolynomial.eval₂ k (fun i => a * x i) f =
      a ^ d * MvPolynomial.eval₂ k x f

name: ChoppedPlane.mulForm_injective
statement:
theorem mulForm_injective (f : Forms K n d) (hf : f.val ≠ 0) :
    Function.Injective (mulForm (e := e) f)

name: ChoppedPlane.mulForm_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem mulForm_val (f : Forms K n d) (a : Forms K n e) :
    (mulForm f a).val = f.val * a.val

name: ChoppedPlane.chart_evaluations_span_dual
statement:
theorem chart_evaluations_span_dual [Infinite K] (d : ℕ) :
    Submodule.span K (Set.range (fun u : Fin 2 → K =>
      evaluationLinear K 3 d ![u 0, u 1, 1])) = ⊤

name: ChoppedPlane.choppedIdeal_le_pointIdeal
statement:
theorem choppedIdeal_le_pointIdeal {p d : ℕ} (a : PointCoordinates K p) :
    choppedIdeal K a d ≤ pointIdeal K a

name: ChoppedPlane.exists_independent_chart_evaluations
statement:
theorem exists_independent_chart_evaluations [Infinite K] (d q : ℕ)
    (hq : q ≤ (d + 2).choose 2) :
    ∃ u : Fin q → Fin 2 → K,
      LinearIndependent K (fun i => evaluationLinear K 3 d ![u i 0, u i 1, 1])

name: ChoppedPlane.exists_pointHilbertFunction_maximal
statement:
theorem exists_pointHilbertFunction_maximal [Infinite K] (p d : ℕ) :
    ∃ a : PointCoordinates K p,
      pointHilbertFunction K a d = min ((d + 2).choose 2) p

name: ChoppedPlane.homogeneous_eq_zero_of_chart_evaluations
statement:
theorem homogeneous_eq_zero_of_chart_evaluations [Infinite K] {d : ℕ}
    (f : Forms K 3 d) (h : ∀ a b : K, eval ![a, b, 1] f.val = 0) : f = 0

name: ChoppedPlane.homogeneous_mem_pointIdeal_iff
statement:
theorem homogeneous_mem_pointIdeal_iff {p d : ℕ} (a : PointCoordinates K p)
    (f : Forms K 3 d) :
    f.val ∈ pointIdeal K a ↔ f ∈ pointDegreePiece K a d

name: ChoppedPlane.homogeneous_mem_singlePointIdeal_iff
statement:
theorem homogeneous_mem_singlePointIdeal_iff {d : ℕ} (a b : K)
    (f : Forms K 3 d) :
    f.val ∈ singlePointIdeal K a b ↔ eval ![a, b, 1] f.val = 0

name: ChoppedPlane.mem_pointDegreePiece
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_pointDegreePiece {p d : ℕ} (a : PointCoordinates K p)
    (f : Forms K 3 d) :
    f ∈ pointDegreePiece K a d ↔ ∀ i, eval (chartPoint K a i) f.val = 0

name: ChoppedPlane.pointDegreeSpace_homogeneous
statement:
theorem pointDegreeSpace_homogeneous {p d : ℕ} (a : PointCoordinates K p) :
    pointDegreeSpace K a d ≤ Forms K 3 d

name: ChoppedPlane.pointEvaluation_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem pointEvaluation_apply {p d : ℕ} (a : PointCoordinates K p)
    (f : Forms K 3 d) (i : Fin p) :
    pointEvaluation K a d f i = eval (chartPoint K a i) f.val

name: ChoppedPlane.pointHilbertFunction_eq_rank
statement:
theorem pointHilbertFunction_eq_rank {p d : ℕ} (a : PointCoordinates K p) :
    pointHilbertFunction K a d = finrank K (pointEvaluation K a d).range

name: ChoppedPlane.pointHilbertFunction_le
statement:
theorem pointHilbertFunction_le {p d : ℕ} (a : PointCoordinates K p) :
    pointHilbertFunction K a d ≤ min ((d + 2).choose 2) p

name: ChoppedPlane.sub_substitution_mem
statement:
theorem sub_substitution_mem (I : Ideal (Poly K 3)) (q : Fin 3 → Poly K 3)
    (hq : ∀ i, X i - q i ∈ I) (f : Poly K 3) :
    f - eval₂ C q f ∈ I

name: ChoppedPlane.card_maximalSpectrum_eq_finrank
statement:
theorem card_maximalSpectrum_eq_finrank :
    Nat.card (MaximalSpectrum A) = Module.finrank K A

name: ChoppedPlane.affinePresentation_apply
statement:
theorem affinePresentation_apply
    (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K →ₐ[K] (Fin p → K))
    (f : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K) (i : Fin p) :
    φ f i = eval (fun j => affinePresentationCoordinates φ (i, j)) f

name: ChoppedPlane.affinePresentation_distinct
statement:
theorem affinePresentation_distinct
    (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K →ₐ[K] (Fin p → K))
    (hφ : Function.Surjective φ) : DistinctPoints K (affinePresentationCoordinates φ)

name: ChoppedPlane.affinePresentation_ker
statement:
theorem affinePresentation_ker
    (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K →ₐ[K] (Fin p → K))
    (f : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K) :
    φ f = 0 ↔ ∀ i, eval (fun j => affinePresentationCoordinates φ (i, j)) f = 0

name: ChoppedPlane.exists_affine_point_presentation
statement:
theorem exists_affine_point_presentation [IsAlgClosed K]
    (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K))
    [Module.Finite K (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K ⧸ I)]
    [IsReduced (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K ⧸ I)]
    (h : Module.finrank K (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K ⧸ I) = p) :
    ∃ φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K →ₐ[K] (Fin p → K),
      Function.Surjective φ ∧ DistinctPoints K (affinePresentationCoordinates φ) ∧
      ∀ f, φ f = 0 ↔ f ∈ I

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.binaryEmbedding_X_homogeneous
statement:
theorem binaryEmbedding_X_homogeneous (i : Fin 2) :
    (binaryEmbedding (R := R) (X i)).IsHomogeneous 1

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.binaryRestriction_X_homogeneous
statement:
theorem binaryRestriction_X_homogeneous (i : Fin 3) :
    (binaryRestriction (R := R) (X i)).IsHomogeneous 1

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.binaryRestriction_embedding
statement:
@[simp] theorem binaryRestriction_embedding (P : Binary R) :
    binaryRestriction (binaryEmbedding P) = P

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.directional_C
statement:
@[simp] theorem directional_C (f : Fin 3 → R) (r : R) :
    directional f (C r) = 0

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.directional_X
statement:
@[simp] theorem directional_X (f : Fin 3 → R) (i : Fin 3) :
    directional f (X i) = C (f i)

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.directional_linearChange
statement:
theorem directional_linearChange (f : Fin 3 → R)
    (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) R)
    (hA : ∀ i, ∑ j, f j * A i j = if i = 0 then 1 else 0)
    (P : Aux R) :
    directional f (linearChange A P) = linearChange A (pderiv 0 P)

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.directional_linearForm
statement:
@[simp] theorem directional_linearForm (f v : Fin 3 → R) :
    directional f (linearForm v) = C (∑ i, f i * v i)

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.first_derivative_split
statement:
theorem first_derivative_split :
    (integrateFirst (K := K)).comp (pderiv (R := R) (0 : Fin 3)).toLinearMap +
      zeroFirst = LinearMap.id

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.integrateFirst_monomial
statement:
@[simp] theorem integrateFirst_monomial (s : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) (r : R) :
    integrateFirst (K := K) (monomial s r) =
      monomial (s + Finsupp.single 0 1)
        (r * algebraMap K R (((s 0 + 1 : ℕ) : K)⁻¹))

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.integrateFirst_pderiv_add_zeroFirst
statement:
theorem integrateFirst_pderiv_add_zeroFirst (P : Aux R) :
    integrateFirst (K := K) (pderiv 0 P) + zeroFirst P = P

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.kernelCoordinates_embedding
statement:
theorem kernelCoordinates_embedding (A B : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) R)
    (hAB : A * B = 1) (Q : BinaryTensor (R := R) (M := M)) :
    kernelCoordinates B (kernelEmbedding A Q) = Q

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.kernelCoordinates_homogeneous
statement:
theorem kernelCoordinates_homogeneous (B : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) R)
    {n : ℕ} {P : AuxTensor (R := R) (M := M)} (hP : TensorHomogeneous n P) :
    TensorHomogeneous n (kernelCoordinates B P)

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.linearChange_C
statement:
@[simp] theorem linearChange_C (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) R) (r : R) :
    linearChange A (C r) = C r

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.linearChange_X
statement:
@[simp] theorem linearChange_X (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) R) (i : Fin 3) :
    linearChange A (X i) = linearForm (A i)

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.linearChange_comp
statement:
theorem linearChange_comp (A B : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) R) :
    (linearChange A).comp (linearChange B) = linearChange (B * A)

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.linearChange_homogeneous
statement:
@[simp] theorem linearChange_homogeneous (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) R)
    {n : ℕ} {P : Aux R} (hP : P.IsHomogeneous n) :
    (linearChange A P).IsHomogeneous n

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.linearChange_linearForm
statement:
theorem linearChange_linearForm (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) R) (v : Fin 3 → R) :
    linearChange A (linearForm v) = linearForm (fun k => ∑ j, v j * A j k)

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.linearChange_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem linearChange_one :
    linearChange (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) R) = AlgHom.id R (Aux R)

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.linearForm_homogeneous
statement:
@[simp] theorem linearForm_homogeneous (v : Fin 3 → R) :
    (linearForm v).IsHomogeneous 1

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.linearForm_one_row
statement:
@[simp] theorem linearForm_one_row (i : Fin 3) :
    linearForm ((1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) R) i) = X i

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.linearSubstitution_homogeneous
statement:
theorem linearSubstitution_homogeneous
    (φ : MvPolynomial σ R →ₐ[R] MvPolynomial τ R)
    (hφ : ∀ i, (φ (X i)).IsHomogeneous 1)
    {n : ℕ} {P : MvPolynomial σ R} (hP : P.IsHomogeneous n) :
    (φ P).IsHomogeneous n

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.linearSubstitution_homogeneousComponent
statement:
theorem linearSubstitution_homogeneousComponent
    (φ : MvPolynomial σ R →ₐ[R] MvPolynomial τ R)
    (hφ : ∀ i, (φ (X i)).IsHomogeneous 1)
    (n : ℕ) (P : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    homogeneousComponent n (φ P) = φ (homogeneousComponent n P)

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.pderiv_binaryEmbedding
statement:
@[simp] theorem pderiv_binaryEmbedding (P : Binary R) :
    pderiv (0 : Fin 3) (binaryEmbedding P) = 0

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.tensorBinaryEmbedding_injective
statement:
theorem tensorBinaryEmbedding_injective :
    Function.Injective (tensorBinaryEmbedding (R := R) (M := M))

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.tensorBinaryRestriction_embedding
statement:
@[simp] theorem tensorBinaryRestriction_embedding (P : BinaryTensor (R := R) (M := M)) :
    tensorBinaryRestriction (tensorBinaryEmbedding P) = P

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.tensor_directional_homogeneous_kernel
statement:
theorem tensor_directional_homogeneous_kernel
    (f : Fin 3 → R) (A B : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) R)
    (hAB : A * B = 1) (hBA : B * A = 1)
    (hA : ∀ i, ∑ j, f j * A i j = if i = 0 then 1 else 0)
    {n : ℕ} (P : AuxTensor (R := R) (M := M)) (hP : TensorHomogeneous n P) :
    tensorDirectional f P = 0 ↔
      ∃! Q : BinaryTensor (R := R) (M := M),
        TensorHomogeneous n Q ∧ kernelEmbedding A Q = P

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.tensor_directional_kernel
statement:
theorem tensor_directional_kernel
    (f : Fin 3 → R) (A B : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) R)
    (hAB : A * B = 1) (hBA : B * A = 1)
    (hA : ∀ i, ∑ j, f j * A i j = if i = 0 then 1 else 0)
    (P : AuxTensor (R := R) (M := M)) :
    tensorDirectional f P = 0 ↔
      ∃! Q : BinaryTensor (R := R) (M := M), kernelEmbedding A Q = P

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.tensor_first_derivative_split
statement:
theorem tensor_first_derivative_split (P : AuxTensor (R := R) (M := M)) :
    (integrateFirst (K := K)).rTensor M ((pderiv (R := R) (0 : Fin 3)).toLinearMap.rTensor M P) +
      tensorBinaryEmbedding (tensorBinaryRestriction P) = P

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.tensor_linearSubstitution_homogeneous
statement:
theorem tensor_linearSubstitution_homogeneous
    (φ : MvPolynomial σ R →ₐ[R] MvPolynomial τ R)
    (hφ : ∀ i, (φ (X i)).IsHomogeneous 1)
    {n : ℕ} {P : MvPolynomial σ R ⊗[R] M} (hP : TensorHomogeneous n P) :
    TensorHomogeneous n (φ.toLinearMap.rTensor M P)

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.tensor_pderiv_kernel
statement:
theorem tensor_pderiv_kernel (P : AuxTensor (R := R) (M := M)) :

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.zeroFirst_monomial

name: ChoppedPlane.linear_cech_cross_descent
statement:
theorem linear_cech_cross_descent
    (dA : A₁ →ₗ[R] A₂) (dB : B₁ →ₗ[R] B₂)
    (l₁ : A₁ →ₗ[R] B₁) (l₂ : A₂ →ₗ[R] B₂)
    (q₁ : B₁ →ₗ[R] C₁) (q₂ : B₂ →ₗ[R] C₂) (dC : C₁ →ₗ[R] C₂)
    (hcomm : ∀ a, dB (l₁ a) = l₂ (dA a))
    (hcross : ∀ b, dC (q₁ b) = q₂ (dB b))
    (hdB : Function.Injective dB) (hl₂ : Function.Injective l₂)
    (hdC : Function.Injective dC)
    (hker₁ : LinearMap.ker q₁ = LinearMap.range l₁)
    (hzero₂ : ∀ a, q₂ (l₂ a) = 0) :
    ∀ a, l₂ a ∈ LinearMap.range dB → a ∈ LinearMap.range dA

name: ChoppedPlane.linear_cech_vanishing_iff
statement:
theorem linear_cech_vanishing_iff
    (dA : A₁ →ₗ[R] A₂) (dB : B₁ →ₗ[R] B₂)
    (l₁ : A₁ →ₗ[R] B₁) (l₂ : A₂ →ₗ[R] B₂)
    (hcomm : ∀ a, dB (l₁ a) = l₂ (dA a))
    (hdB : Function.Injective dB) (hl₂ : Function.Injective l₂) :
    (∀ a, l₂ a ∈ LinearMap.range dB → a ∈ LinearMap.range dA) ↔
      (∀ b, dB b ∈ LinearMap.range l₂ → b ∈ LinearMap.range l₁)

    ∃ a : ι → K, ∀ j, eval a (D j) ≠ 0

name: ChoppedPlane.rank_polynomial_principal_open
statement:
theorem rank_polynomial_principal_open [FiniteDimensional K V] [FiniteDimensional K W]
    (A : (ι → K) → (V →ₗ[K] W)) (hA : IsPolynomialFamily A) (a₀ : ι → K) :
    ∃ D : MvPolynomial ι K, eval a₀ D ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ a, eval a D ≠ 0 →
      finrank K (LinearMap.range (A a₀)) ≤ finrank K (LinearMap.range (A a))

name: ChoppedPlane.simultaneous_maximum_rank_principal_open
statement:
theorem simultaneous_maximum_rank_principal_open [Infinite K]
    [FiniteDimensional K V] [FiniteDimensional K W]
    {J : Type*} [Fintype J]
    (A : J → (ι → K) → (V →ₗ[K] W)) (hA : ∀ j, IsPolynomialFamily (A j)) :
    ∃ D : MvPolynomial ι K, (∃ a, eval a D ≠ 0) ∧
      ∀ a, eval a D ≠ 0 → ∀ j b,
        finrank K (LinearMap.range (A j b)) ≤ finrank K (LinearMap.range (A j a))

name: ChoppedPlane.simultaneous_principal_properties
statement:
theorem simultaneous_principal_properties [Infinite K] {J : Type*} [Fintype J]
    (P : J → (ι → K) → Prop)
    (hP : ∀ j, ∃ D : MvPolynomial ι K, (∃ a, eval a D ≠ 0) ∧
      ∀ a, eval a D ≠ 0 → P j a) :
    ∃ a : ι → K, ∀ j, P j a

name: ChoppedPlane.exists_matrix_kernel_chart
statement:
theorem exists_matrix_kernel_chart [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n]
    (E : Matrix m n (MvPolynomial ι K)) (a₀ : ι → K)
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective (polynomialMatrixEval (RingHom.id K) a₀ E).mulVecLin) :
    ∃ S : Matrix n m (MvPolynomial ι K), eval a₀ (E * S).det = 1

name: ChoppedPlane.exists_rank_minor
statement:
theorem exists_rank_minor (A : Matrix m n K) :
    ∃ (rows : Fin A.rank → m) (cols : Fin A.rank → n),
      (A.submatrix rows cols).det ≠ 0

name: ChoppedPlane.matrixKernelChart_range_ker
statement:
theorem matrixKernelChart_range_ker [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n]
    (E : Matrix m n K) (S : Matrix n m K) (hdet : (E * S).det ≠ 0) :
    LinearMap.range (matrixKernelChart E S).mulVecLin = LinearMap.ker E.mulVecLin ∧
      Function.Surjective E.mulVecLin

name: ChoppedPlane.matrix_det_map
statement:
theorem matrix_det_map {R S j : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [Fintype j] [DecidableEq j] (k : R →+* S) (A : Matrix j j R) :
    (A.map k).det = k A.det

name: ChoppedPlane.matrix_rank_map_field
statement:
theorem matrix_rank_map_field (k : K →+* L) (A : Matrix m n K) :
    (A.map k).rank = A.rank

name: ChoppedPlane.polynomialMatrixEval_kernelChart
statement:
theorem polynomialMatrixEval_kernelChart [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n]
    (k : K →+* L) (a : ι → L)
    (E : Matrix m n (MvPolynomial ι K)) (S : Matrix n m (MvPolynomial ι K)) :
    polynomialMatrixEval k a (matrixKernelChart E S) =
      matrixKernelChart (polynomialMatrixEval k a E) (polynomialMatrixEval k a S)

name: ChoppedPlane.polynomialMatrixEval_map_parameter
statement:
theorem polynomialMatrixEval_map_parameter (k : K →+* L) (a : ι → K)
    (A : Matrix m n (MvPolynomial ι K)) :
    polynomialMatrixEval k (k ∘ a) A =
      (polynomialMatrixEval (RingHom.id K) a A).map k

name: ChoppedPlane.polynomialMatrixEval_rank_map_parameter
statement:
theorem polynomialMatrixEval_rank_map_parameter (k : K →+* L) (a : ι → K)
    (A : Matrix m n (MvPolynomial ι K)) :
    (polynomialMatrixEval k (k ∘ a) A).rank =
      (polynomialMatrixEval (RingHom.id K) a A).rank

name: ChoppedPlane.polynomialMatrixEval_submatrix
statement:
theorem polynomialMatrixEval_submatrix {r : ℕ} (k : K →+* L) (a : ι → L)
    (A : Matrix m n (MvPolynomial ι K)) (rows : Fin r → m) (cols : Fin r → n) :
    (polynomialMatrixEval k a A).submatrix rows cols =
      (A.submatrix rows cols).map (eval₂Hom k a)

name: ChoppedPlane.polynomial_kernel_chart_baseChange
statement:
theorem polynomial_kernel_chart_baseChange [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n]
    (k : K →+* L) (a : ι → L)
    (E : Matrix m n (MvPolynomial ι K)) (S : Matrix n m (MvPolynomial ι K))
    (hdet : eval₂ k a (E * S).det ≠ 0) :
    LinearMap.range (polynomialMatrixEval k a (matrixKernelChart E S)).mulVecLin =
      LinearMap.ker (polynomialMatrixEval k a E).mulVecLin ∧
      Function.Surjective (polynomialMatrixEval k a E).mulVecLin

name: ChoppedPlane.polynomial_matrix_rank_descent
statement:
theorem polynomial_matrix_rank_descent [Infinite K] (k : K →+* L)
    (A : Matrix m n (MvPolynomial ι K)) (a₀ : ι → L) :
    ∃ D : MvPolynomial ι K, (∃ a : ι → K, eval a D ≠ 0) ∧
      ∀ a : ι → K, eval a D ≠ 0 →
        (polynomialMatrixEval k a₀ A).rank ≤
          (polynomialMatrixEval (RingHom.id K) a A).rank

name: ChoppedPlane.polynomial_matrix_ranks_descent
statement:
theorem polynomial_matrix_ranks_descent [Infinite K]
    {J : Type*} [Fintype J] {rows cols : J → Type*}
    [∀ j, Fintype (rows j)] [∀ j, Fintype (cols j)]
    (k : K →+* L) (A : ∀ j, Matrix (rows j) (cols j) (MvPolynomial ι K))
    (a₀ : J → ι → L) (Q : MvPolynomial ι K) (hQ : Q ≠ 0) :
    ∃ D : MvPolynomial ι K, (∃ a : ι → K, eval a D ≠ 0) ∧
      ∀ a : ι → K, eval a D ≠ 0 → eval a Q ≠ 0 ∧
        ∀ j, (polynomialMatrixEval k (a₀ j) (A j)).rank ≤
          (polynomialMatrixEval (RingHom.id K) a (A j)).rank

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.chart_sup_eq_supported
ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.freeLaurentEquiv_coeff
statement:
@[simp] theorem freeLaurentEquiv_coeff [Finite ι] (p : FreeLaurent K ι)
    (i : ι) (e : ℤ × ℤ) : (freeLaurentEquiv p i).coeff e = p (i, e)

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.freeNegativePart_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem freeNegativePart_apply (p : FreeLaurent K ι) (i : ι) (e : ℤ × ℤ) :
    freeNegativePart p (i,e) = if e.1 < 0 ∧ e.2 < 0 then p (i,e) else 0

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.ker_negativePart
statement: theorem ker_negativePart : LinearMap.ker (negativePart (K := K)) = chartU ⊔ chartV

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.ker_negativeProjection
statement: theorem ker_negativeProjection : LinearMap.ker (negativeProjection (K := K)) = chartU ⊔ chartV

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.negativeCoordinates_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem negativeCoordinates_apply (g : ι → ℤ) (r : ℤ)
    (p : negativeGrade (K := K) g r) (e : PositiveIndex g r) :
    negativeCoordinates g r p e = p.val (complementIndex g r e).val

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.negativePart_coeff
statement:
@[simp] theorem negativePart_coeff (p : BinaryLaurent K) (e : ℤ × ℤ) :
    (negativePart p).coeff e = if e.1 < 0 ∧ e.2 < 0 then p.coeff e else 0

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.negativePart_eq_self
statement:
theorem negativePart_eq_self {p : BinaryLaurent K} (hp : p ∈ negativeSpace) :
    negativePart p = p

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.negativePart_mem
statement: theorem negativePart_mem (p : BinaryLaurent K) : negativePart p ∈ negativeSpace

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.negativeProjection_surjective
statement: theorem negativeProjection_surjective : Function.Surjective (negativeProjection (K := K))

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.negativeQuotientEquiv_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem negativeQuotientEquiv_mk (p : BinaryLaurent K) :
    negativeQuotientEquiv ((chartU ⊔ chartV).mkQ p) = negativeProjection p

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.negativeShift_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem negativeShift_apply (g : ι → ℤ) (r : ℤ) (m : ℕ × ℕ)
    (p : negativeGrade (K := K) g (r+m.1+m.2)) (i : ι) (e : ℤ × ℤ) :
    (negativeShift g r m p).val (i,e) =
      if e.1 < 0 ∧ e.2 < 0 then p.val (i,(e.1-m.1,e.2-m.2)) else 0

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.positiveBasis_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem positiveBasis_val (g : ι → ℤ) (r : ℤ) (e : PositiveIndex g r) :
    (positiveBasis (K := K) g r e).val = Finsupp.single e.val 1

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.positiveCoordinates_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem positiveCoordinates_apply (g : ι → ℤ) (r : ℤ)
    (p : positiveGrade (K := K) g r) (e : PositiveIndex g r) :
    positiveCoordinates g r p e = p.val e.val

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.positiveShift_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem positiveShift_apply (g : ι → ℤ) (r : ℤ) (m : ℕ × ℕ)
    (p : positiveGrade (K := K) g r) (i : ι) (e : ℤ × ℤ) :
    (positiveShift g r m p).val (i,e) = p.val (i,(e.1-m.1,e.2-m.2))

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.positiveShift_basis
statement:
@[simp] theorem positiveShift_basis (g : ι → ℤ) (r : ℤ) (m : ℕ × ℕ)
    (e : PositiveIndex g r) :
    positiveShift g r m (positiveBasis (K := K) g r e) =
      positiveBasis g (r+m.1+m.2) (positiveIndexShift g r m e)

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.residuePair_basis
statement:
@[simp] theorem residuePair_basis [Finite ι] (g : ι → ℤ) (r : ℤ)
    (q : negativeGrade (K := K) g r) (e : PositiveIndex g r) :
    residuePair g r q (positiveBasis g r e) = q.val (complementIndex g r e).val

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.residuePair_shift
statement:
theorem residuePair_shift [Finite ι] (g : ι → ℤ) (r : ℤ) (m : ℕ × ℕ)
    (q : negativeGrade (K := K) g (r+m.1+m.2)) (p : positiveGrade (K := K) g r) :
    residuePair g (r+m.1+m.2) q (positiveShift g r m p) =
      residuePair g r (negativeShift g r m q) p

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.shift_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem shift_apply (m : ℤ × ℤ) (p : FreeLaurent K ι) (i : ι) (e : ℤ × ℤ) :
    shift m p (i,e) = p (i,(e.1-m.1,e.2-m.2))

name: ChoppedPlane.BinaryChartRings.range_uEmbedding
statement: theorem range_uEmbedding : LinearMap.range (uEmbedding (K := K)).toLinearMap = chartU

name: ChoppedPlane.BinaryChartRings.range_uIndex
statement: theorem range_uIndex : Set.range uIndex = {e : ℤ × ℤ | 0 ≤ e.2}

name: ChoppedPlane.BinaryChartRings.range_vEmbedding
statement: theorem range_vEmbedding : LinearMap.range (vEmbedding (K := K)).toLinearMap = chartV

name: ChoppedPlane.BinaryChartRings.range_vIndex
statement: theorem range_vIndex : Set.range vIndex = {e : ℤ × ℤ | 0 ≤ e.1}

name: ChoppedPlane.BinaryChartRings.uEmbedding_injective
statement: theorem uEmbedding_injective : Function.Injective (uEmbedding (K := K))

name: ChoppedPlane.BinaryChartRings.uEmbedding_u
statement: @[simp] theorem uEmbedding_u : uEmbedding (uU (K := K)) = U

name: ChoppedPlane.BinaryChartRings.uEmbedding_v
statement: @[simp] theorem uEmbedding_v : uEmbedding (vU (K := K)) = V

name: ChoppedPlane.BinaryChartRings.uIndex_injective
statement: theorem uIndex_injective : Function.Injective uIndex

name: ChoppedPlane.BinaryChartRings.uU_mul_inv
statement: @[simp] theorem uU_mul_inv : uU (K := K) * uUInv = 1

name: ChoppedPlane.BinaryChartRings.vEmbedding_injective
statement: theorem vEmbedding_injective : Function.Injective (vEmbedding (K := K))

name: ChoppedPlane.BinaryChartRings.vEmbedding_u
statement: @[simp] theorem vEmbedding_u : vEmbedding (uV (K := K)) = U

name: ChoppedPlane.BinaryChartRings.vEmbedding_v
statement: @[simp] theorem vEmbedding_v : vEmbedding (vV (K := K)) = V

name: ChoppedPlane.BinaryChartRings.vIndex_injective
statement: theorem vIndex_injective : Function.Injective vIndex

name: ChoppedPlane.BinaryChartRings.vV_mul_inv
statement: @[simp] theorem vV_mul_inv : vV (K := K) * vVInv = 1

name: ChoppedPlane.determinant_homogeneous_rows
statement:
theorem determinant_homogeneous_rows {K : Type*} [Field K] {n m : ℕ}
    (B : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) (Poly K n)) (δ : Fin m → ℕ)
    (hB : ∀ i j, (B i j).IsHomogeneous (δ i)) :
    B.det.IsHomogeneous (∑ i, δ i)

name: ChoppedPlane.maximalMinor_homogeneous
statement:
theorem maximalMinor_homogeneous {K : Type*} [Field K] {n : ℕ}
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K n)) (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ)
    (hB : ∀ i j, (B i j).IsHomogeneous (δ i)) (i : Fin (c + 1)) :
    (maximalMinor B i).IsHomogeneous (∑ j : Fin c, δ (i.succAbove j))

name: ChoppedPlane.signedMaximalMinor_relation
statement:
theorem signedMaximalMinor_relation (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) R) (j : Fin c) :
    ∑ i, signedMaximalMinor B i * B i j = 0

name: ChoppedPlane.cofactorMap_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem cofactorMap_apply (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) R)
    (v : Fin (c + 1) → R) : cofactorMap B v = ∑ i, signedMaximalMinor B i * v i

name: ChoppedPlane.cofactorMap_map
statement:
theorem cofactorMap_map {S : Type*} [CommRing S] (φ : R →+* S)
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) R) (v : Fin (c + 1) → R) :
    cofactorMap (B.map φ) (fun i => φ (v i)) = φ (cofactorMap B v)

name: ChoppedPlane.cofactorMap_mulVec
statement:
theorem cofactorMap_mulVec (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) R) (w : Fin c → R) :
    cofactorMap B (B.mulVec w) = 0

name: ChoppedPlane.cofactorMap_range_eq_span
statement:
theorem cofactorMap_range_eq_span (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) R) :
    (cofactorMap B).range = Submodule.span R (Set.range (signedMaximalMinor B))

name: ChoppedPlane.exists_maximalMinor_ne_zero_of_primitive
statement:
theorem exists_maximalMinor_ne_zero_of_primitive
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) R) (h : PrimitiveMaximalMinors B) :
    ∃ i, maximalMinor B i ≠ 0

name: ChoppedPlane.ker_cofactorMap_eq_range
statement:
theorem ker_cofactorMap_eq_range
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) R) (hprimitive : PrimitiveMaximalMinors B) :
    (cofactorMap B).ker = B.mulVecLin.range

name: ChoppedPlane.ker_cofactorMap_eq_range_field
statement:
theorem ker_cofactorMap_eq_range_field
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) K)
    (hminor : ∃ i, maximalMinor B i ≠ 0) :
    (cofactorMap B).ker = B.mulVecLin.range

name: ChoppedPlane.maximalMinor_map
statement:
theorem maximalMinor_map {S : Type*} [CommRing S] (φ : R →+* S)
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) R) (i : Fin (c + 1)) :
    maximalMinor (B.map φ) i = φ (maximalMinor B i)

name: ChoppedPlane.maximalMinor_mul_solution_integer
statement:
theorem maximalMinor_mul_solution_integer
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) R) (v : Fin (c + 1) → R) (w : Fin c → F)
    (h : (B.map (algebraMap R F)).mulVec w = fun i => algebraMap R F (v i))
    (i : Fin (c + 1)) (k : Fin c) :
    IsInteger R (algebraMap R F (maximalMinor B i) * w k)

name: ChoppedPlane.mulVec_injective_of_maximalMinor_ne_zero
statement:
theorem mulVec_injective_of_maximalMinor_ne_zero
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) K) (i : Fin (c + 1))
    (h : maximalMinor B i ≠ 0) : Function.Injective B.mulVec

name: ChoppedPlane.mulVec_injective_of_primitive
statement:
theorem mulVec_injective_of_primitive
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) R) (hprimitive : PrimitiveMaximalMinors B) :
    Function.Injective B.mulVec

name: ChoppedPlane.primitiveMaximalMinors_of_relPrime_pair
statement:
theorem primitiveMaximalMinors_of_relPrime_pair
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) R) (i j : Fin (c + 1))
    (h : IsRelPrime (maximalMinor B i) (maximalMinor B j)) : PrimitiveMaximalMinors B

name: ChoppedPlane.range_mulVec_le_ker_cofactorMap
statement:
theorem range_mulVec_le_ker_cofactorMap (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) R) :
    B.mulVecLin.range ≤ (cofactorMap B).ker

name: ChoppedPlane.reduced_den_dvd_of_integer_multiple
statement:
theorem reduced_den_dvd_of_integer_multiple (x : F) (m : R)
    (h : IsInteger R (algebraMap R F m * x)) : (den R x : R) ∣ m

name: ChoppedPlane.signedMaximalMinor_map
statement:
theorem signedMaximalMinor_map {S : Type*} [CommRing S] (φ : R →+* S)
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) R) (i : Fin (c + 1)) :
    signedMaximalMinor (B.map φ) i = φ (signedMaximalMinor B i)

name: ChoppedPlane.N_ge_degree_add_one
statement: theorem N_ge_degree_add_one (t : ℕ) : t + 1 ≤ N t

name: ChoppedPlane.N_succ
statement: theorem N_succ (t : ℕ) : N (t + 1) = N t + (t + 2)

name: ChoppedPlane.N_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem N_zero : N 0 = 1

name: ChoppedPlane.N₂_nat
statement: @[simp] theorem N₂_nat (t : ℕ) : N₂ (t : ℤ) = (N t : ℤ)

name: ChoppedPlane.N₂_neg
statement: @[simp] theorem N₂_neg {t : ℤ} (h : t < 0) : N₂ t = 0

name: ChoppedPlane.block_dimension_identity
statement:
theorem block_dimension_identity (d r e : ℕ) :
    aCount d r * N₂ ((e : ℤ) - 1) - cCount d r * N₂ ((e : ℤ) - 2) =
      residual d r e

name: ChoppedPlane.block_max_identity
statement:
theorem block_max_identity (d r e : ℕ) :
    max (aCount d r * N₂ ((e : ℤ) - 1) -
      cCount d r * N₂ ((e : ℤ) - 2)) 0 = max (residual d r e) 0

name: ChoppedPlane.block_rank_gap
statement: theorem block_rank_gap {d r : ℕ} (hr : 3 ≤ r) : 2 ≤ cCount d r - aCount d r

name: ChoppedPlane.cCount_pos
statement: theorem cCount_pos {d r : ℕ} (hrd : r ≤ d) : 0 < cCount d r

name: ChoppedPlane.cast_max_sub
statement:
theorem cast_max_sub (p n m : ℕ) :
    ((max p (n - m) : ℕ) : ℤ) = max (p : ℤ) ((n : ℤ) - (m : ℤ))

name: ChoppedPlane.column_count_sum
statement:
theorem column_count_sum (d r : ℕ) :
    linearColumnCount d r + quadraticColumnCount d r = (r : ℤ) - 1

name: ChoppedPlane.column_degree_sum
statement:
theorem column_degree_sum (d r : ℕ) :
    linearColumnCount d r + 2 * quadraticColumnCount d r = (d : ℤ)

name: ChoppedPlane.count_difference
statement: theorem count_difference (d r : ℕ) : cCount d r - aCount d r = (r : ℤ) - 1

name: ChoppedPlane.count_relation
statement: theorem count_relation (d r : ℕ) : (r : ℤ) + aCount d r = cCount d r + 1

name: ChoppedPlane.cutoff_as_intceil
statement:
theorem cutoff_as_intceil (d r : ℕ) :
    cutoff d r = max 1 (⌈residualThreshold d r⌉.toNat)

name: ChoppedPlane.cutoff_before_second_koszul
statement:
theorem cutoff_before_second_koszul {d r : ℕ}
    (hd : 2 ≤ d) (hr : 3 ≤ r) (hrd : r ≤ d) : d + cutoff d r < 2 * d

name: ChoppedPlane.cutoff_eq_one_of_aCount_nonpos
statement:
theorem cutoff_eq_one_of_aCount_nonpos {d r : ℕ}
    (hr : 3 ≤ r) (ha : aCount d r ≤ 0) : cutoff d r = 1

name: ChoppedPlane.cutoff_is_least
statement:
theorem cutoff_is_least {d r : ℕ} (hr : 3 ≤ r) :
    IsLeast {e : ℕ | 1 ≤ e ∧ residual d r e ≤ 0} (cutoff d r)

name: ChoppedPlane.cutoff_le_iff
statement:
theorem cutoff_le_iff {d r e : ℕ} (he : 1 ≤ e) :
    cutoff d r ≤ e ↔ residualThreshold d r ≤ (e : ℚ)

name: ChoppedPlane.cutoff_le_max
statement:
theorem cutoff_le_max {d r : ℕ} (hd : 3 ≤ d) (hr : 3 ≤ r) :
    cutoff d r ≤ max 1 (d - 3)

name: ChoppedPlane.cutoff_lt_degree
statement:
theorem cutoff_lt_degree {d r : ℕ} (hd : 2 ≤ d) (hr : 3 ≤ r) (hrd : r ≤ d) :
    cutoff d r < d

name: ChoppedPlane.cutoff_pos
statement: theorem cutoff_pos (d r : ℕ) : 1 ≤ cutoff d r

name: ChoppedPlane.first_minor_degree
statement: theorem first_minor_degree (d r : ℕ) : 2 * ((r : ℤ) - 1) + aCount d r = (d : ℤ)

name: ChoppedPlane.generator_count_bounds
statement:
theorem generator_count_bounds {d p : ℕ} (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    (hlo : N (d - 1) < p) (hhi : p < N d) :
    1 ≤ N d - p ∧ N d - p ≤ d

name: ChoppedPlane.hbCoefficient_at_or_above_degree
statement:
theorem hbCoefficient_at_or_above_degree (d r e : ℕ) :
    hbCoefficient d r (d + e) = (N d : ℤ) - r

name: ChoppedPlane.hbCoefficient_below_degree
statement:
theorem hbCoefficient_below_degree {d r : ℕ} {t : ℤ} (ht : t < (d : ℤ)) :
    hbCoefficient d r t = N₂ t

name: ChoppedPlane.hbCoefficient_formula
statement:
theorem hbCoefficient_formula (d r : ℕ) (t : ℤ) :
    hbCoefficient d r t = if t < (d : ℤ) then N₂ t else (N d : ℤ) - r

name: ChoppedPlane.hilbertBurch_coefficient_identity
statement:
theorem hilbertBurch_coefficient_identity (d r e : ℕ) :
    (N (d + e) : ℤ) - (r : ℤ) * (N e : ℤ) -
      aCount d r * N₂ ((e : ℤ) - 1) +
      cCount d r * N₂ ((e : ℤ) - 2) = (N d : ℤ) - r

name: ChoppedPlane.hilbert_max_identity
statement:
theorem hilbert_max_identity (d r e : ℕ) :
    max ((N d : ℤ) - r) ((N (d + e) : ℤ) - (r : ℤ) * (N e : ℤ)) =
      ((N d : ℤ) - r) + max (residual d r e) 0

name: ChoppedPlane.hilbert_max_nat_identity

theorem hilbert_max_nat_identity {d r : ℕ} (hr : r ≤ N d) (e : ℕ) :

      ((N d : ℤ) - r) + max (residual d r e) 0

name: ChoppedPlane.nonpositive_hbCoefficient

      linearColumnCount d r * N₂ (t - d - 1) +
      quadraticColumnCount d r * N₂ (t - d - 2) =
      if t < (d : ℤ) then N₂ t else (N d : ℤ) - r

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.binary_cubic_factor
statement:
theorem binary_cubic_factor (u v q : A) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0) :
    (u - v) * (u - q * v) * (u - q ^ 2 * v) = u ^ 3 - v ^ 3

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.cube_eq_one
statement: theorem cube_eq_one (q : A) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0) : q ^ 3 = 1

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.dual_intertwiners
statement:
theorem dual_intertwiners (u v q : A) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0) :
    let d0 := u - v
    let d1 := u - q * v
    let d2 := u - q ^ 2 * v
    let f0 := quarticU u v + quarticV u v
    let f1 := quarticU u v + q * quarticV u v
    let f2 := quarticU u v + q ^ 2 * quarticV u v
    ((u + q ^ 2 * v) * (u ^ 3 - v ^ 3) * (d1 * d2 ^ 2) =
        f2 * (d0 * d1 ^ 2)) ∧
    ((u + v) * (u ^ 3 - v ^ 3) * (d2 * d0 ^ 2) =
        f0 * (d1 * d2 ^ 2)) ∧
    ((u + q * v) * (u ^ 3 - v ^ 3) * (d0 * d1 ^ 2) =
        f1 * (d2 * d0 ^ 2))

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.intertwiner_one
statement:
theorem intertwiner_one (u v q : A) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0) :
    (u + q * v) * (u ^ 3 - v ^ 3) * weightOne u v q =
      (quarticU u v + q * quarticV u v) * weightTwo u v q

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.intertwiner_two
statement:
theorem intertwiner_two (u v q : A) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0) :
    (u + q ^ 2 * v) * (u ^ 3 - v ^ 3) * weightTwo u v q =
      (quarticU u v + q ^ 2 * quarticV u v) * weightZero u v q

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.intertwiner_zero
statement:
theorem intertwiner_zero (u v q : A) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0) :
    (u + v) * (u ^ 3 - v ^ 3) * weightZero u v q =
      (quarticU u v + quarticV u v) * weightOne u v q

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quadratic_minor_u
statement:
theorem quadratic_minor_u (u v z : A) (hz : z ^ 3 = u ^ 3 + v ^ 3) :
    (z * u) * (-z ^ 2) - (u * v) * v ^ 2 = -quarticU u v

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quadratic_minor_v
statement:
theorem quadratic_minor_v (u v z : A) (hz : z ^ 3 = u ^ 3 + v ^ 3) :
    (u * v) * u ^ 2 - (v * z) * (-z ^ 2) = -quarticV u v

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quadratic_minor_z
statement:
theorem quadratic_minor_z (u v z : A) :
    (v * z) * v ^ 2 - (z * u) * u ^ 2 = -quarticZ u v z

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quartic_bezout_u
statement:
theorem quartic_bezout_u (u v : A) :
    (3 * u ^ 3 + 2 * v ^ 3) * quarticU u v +
      4 * u * v ^ 2 * quarticV u v = 3 * u ^ 7

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quartic_bezout_v
statement:
theorem quartic_bezout_v (u v : A) :
    -4 * u ^ 2 * v * quarticU u v -
      (3 * v ^ 3 + 2 * u ^ 3) * quarticV u v = 3 * v ^ 7

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quartic_binary_cubic
statement:
theorem quartic_binary_cubic (u v : A) :
    quarticU u v ^ 3 + quarticV u v ^ 3 =
      (u ^ 3 + v ^ 3) * (u ^ 3 - v ^ 3) ^ 3

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quartic_factor_of_cube
statement:
theorem quartic_factor_of_cube (u v q : A) (hq3 : q ^ 3 = 1) :
    quarticU u v + q * quarticV u v =
      (u + q * v) * (u - q * v) ^ 3

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quartic_factor_one
statement:
theorem quartic_factor_one (u v q : A) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0) :
    quarticU u v + q * quarticV u v =
      (u + q * v) * (u - q * v) ^ 3

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quartic_factor_two
statement:
theorem quartic_factor_two (u v q : A) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0) :
    quarticU u v + q ^ 2 * quarticV u v =
      (u + q ^ 2 * v) * (u - q ^ 2 * v) ^ 3

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quartic_factor_zero
statement:
theorem quartic_factor_zero (u v : A) :
    quarticU u v + quarticV u v = (u + v) * (u - v) ^ 3

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quartic_preserves_cubic
statement:
theorem quartic_preserves_cubic (u v z : A) (hz : z ^ 3 = u ^ 3 + v ^ 3) :
    quarticU u v ^ 3 + quarticV u v ^ 3 = quarticZ u v z ^ 3

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quartic_quadratic_syzygy_one
statement:
theorem quartic_quadratic_syzygy_one (u v z : A) :
    quarticU u v * (v * z) + quarticV u v * (z * u) +
      quarticZ u v z * (u * v) = 0

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quartic_quadratic_syzygy_two
statement:
theorem quartic_quadratic_syzygy_two (u v z : A)
    (hz : z ^ 3 = u ^ 3 + v ^ 3) :
    quarticU u v * u ^ 2 + quarticV u v * v ^ 2 -
      quarticZ u v z * z ^ 2 = 0

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.shifted_one_dual_intertwiners
statement:
theorem shifted_one_dual_intertwiners (u v q : A) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0) :
    let d0 := u - v
    let d1 := u - q * v
    let d2 := u - q ^ 2 * v
    let f0 := quarticU u v + quarticV u v
    let f1 := quarticU u v + q * quarticV u v
    let f2 := quarticU u v + q ^ 2 * quarticV u v
    ((u + v) * (u + q ^ 2 * v) * (u ^ 3 - v ^ 3) *
        (d0 ^ 2 * d1 * d2 ^ 2) = f0 * f2 * d1 ^ 2) ∧
    ((u ^ 3 - v ^ 3) * (d0 * d2) = d0 ^ 2 * d1 * d2 ^ 2) ∧
    ((u + q * v) * (u ^ 3 - v ^ 3) * d1 ^ 2 = f1 * (d0 * d2))

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.shifted_one_intertwiners
statement:
theorem shifted_one_intertwiners (u v q : A) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0) :
    let d0 := u - v
    let d1 := u - q * v
    let d2 := u - q ^ 2 * v
    let f0 := quarticU u v + quarticV u v
    let f1 := quarticU u v + q * quarticV u v
    let f2 := quarticU u v + q ^ 2 * quarticV u v
    ((u ^ 3 - v ^ 3) * d1 = d0 * d1 ^ 2 * d2) ∧
    ((u + q * v) * (u ^ 3 - v ^ 3) * (d0 * d1 ^ 2 * d2) =
        f1 * (d0 ^ 2 * d2 ^ 2)) ∧
    ((u + v) * (u + q ^ 2 * v) * (u ^ 3 - v ^ 3) *
        (d0 ^ 2 * d2 ^ 2) = f0 * f2 * d1)

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.shifted_two_dual_intertwiners
statement:
theorem shifted_two_dual_intertwiners (u v q : A) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0) :
    let d0 := u - v
    let d1 := u - q * v
    let d2 := u - q ^ 2 * v
    let f0 := quarticU u v + quarticV u v
    let f1 := quarticU u v + q * quarticV u v
    let f2 := quarticU u v + q ^ 2 * quarticV u v
    ((u + q * v) * (u + q ^ 2 * v) * (u ^ 3 - v ^ 3) *
        (d1 ^ 2 * d2 ^ 2) = f1 * f2 * d0) ∧
    ((u + v) * (u ^ 3 - v ^ 3) * (d1 * d2 * d0 ^ 2) =
        f0 * (d1 ^ 2 * d2 ^ 2)) ∧
    ((u ^ 3 - v ^ 3) * d0 = d1 * d2 * d0 ^ 2)

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.shifted_two_intertwiners
statement:
theorem shifted_two_intertwiners (u v q : A) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0) :
    let d0 := u - v
    let d1 := u - q * v
    let d2 := u - q ^ 2 * v
    let f0 := quarticU u v + quarticV u v
    let f1 := quarticU u v + q * quarticV u v
    let f2 := quarticU u v + q ^ 2 * quarticV u v
    ((u + v) * (u ^ 3 - v ^ 3) * d0 ^ 2 = f0 * (d1 * d2)) ∧
    ((u ^ 3 - v ^ 3) * (d1 * d2) = d2 ^ 2 * d0 * d1 ^ 2) ∧
    ((u + q * v) * (u + q ^ 2 * v) * (u ^ 3 - v ^ 3) *
        (d2 ^ 2 * d0 * d1 ^ 2) = f1 * f2 * d0 ^ 2)

name: ChoppedPlane.kernelProduct_polynomial_principal_open
statement:
theorem kernelProduct_polynomial_principal_open
    [FiniteDimensional K W] [FiniteDimensional K T]
    (B : V →ₗ[K] W →ₗ[K] T) (E : (ι → K) → (V →ₗ[K] U))
    (q : J → (ι → K) → V) (hqpoly : ∀ j, IsPolynomialFamily (q j))
    (hqker : ∀ a j, q j a ∈ LinearMap.ker (E a))
    (a₀ : ι → K)
    (hqspan : Submodule.span K (Set.range (fun j => q j a₀)) = LinearMap.ker (E a₀)) :
    ∃ D : MvPolynomial ι K, eval a₀ D ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ a, eval a D ≠ 0 →
      finrank K (kernelProductSpace B (LinearMap.ker (E a₀))) ≤
        finrank K (kernelProductSpace B (LinearMap.ker (E a)))

    (hCker : ∀ a, LinearMap.range (C a) ≤ LinearMap.ker (E a))
    (a₀ : ι → K) (hC₀ : LinearMap.range (C a₀) = LinearMap.ker (E a₀)) :
    ∃ D : MvPolynomial ι K, eval a₀ D ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ a, eval a D ≠ 0 →
      finrank K (kernelProductSpace B (LinearMap.ker (E a₀))) ≤
        finrank K (kernelProductSpace B (LinearMap.ker (E a)))

name: ChoppedPlane.kernelProduct_surjective_principal_open
statement:
theorem kernelProduct_surjective_principal_open
    [FiniteDimensional K V] [FiniteDimensional K U]
    [FiniteDimensional K W] [FiniteDimensional K T]
    (B : V →ₗ[K] W →ₗ[K] T)
    (E : (ι → K) → (V →ₗ[K] U)) (hE : IsPolynomialFamily E)
    (a₀ : ι → K) (hsurj : Function.Surjective (E a₀)) :
    ∃ D : MvPolynomial ι K, eval a₀ D ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ a, eval a D ≠ 0 → Function.Surjective (E a) ∧
        finrank K (LinearMap.ker (E a)) = finrank K (LinearMap.ker (E a₀)) ∧
        finrank K (kernelProductSpace B (LinearMap.ker (E a₀))) ≤
          finrank K (kernelProductSpace B (LinearMap.ker (E a)))

name: ChoppedPlane.polynomial_kernel_chart
statement:
theorem polynomial_kernel_chart [FiniteDimensional K V] [FiniteDimensional K U]
    (E : (ι → K) → (V →ₗ[K] U)) (hE : IsPolynomialFamily E)
    (a₀ : ι → K) (hsurj : Function.Surjective (E a₀)) :
    ∃ (D : MvPolynomial ι K) (C : (ι → K) → (V →ₗ[K] V)),
      IsPolynomialFamily C ∧ eval a₀ D = 1 ∧
      (∀ a, LinearMap.range (C a) ≤ LinearMap.ker (E a)) ∧
      (∀ a, eval a D ≠ 0 → LinearMap.range (C a) = LinearMap.ker (E a) ∧
        Function.Surjective (E a)) ∧
      (∀ v, v ∈ LinearMap.ker (E a₀) → C a₀ v = v)

name: ChoppedPlane.columnGradedCofactorMap_range_eq_idealPiece
statement:
theorem columnGradedCofactorMap_range_eq_idealPiece
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K n)) (ε : Fin c → ℕ)
    (hB : ∀ i j, (B i j).IsHomogeneous (ε j)) (e : ℤ) :
    (columnGradedCofactorMap B ε hB e).range = columnMinorIdealPiece B ε e

name: ChoppedPlane.columnGradedMatrixMap_injective
statement:
theorem columnGradedMatrixMap_injective
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K n)) (ε : Fin c → ℕ)
    (hB : ∀ i j, (B i j).IsHomogeneous (ε j))
    (hprimitive : PrimitiveMaximalMinors B) (e : ℤ) :
    Function.Injective (columnGradedMatrixMap B ε hB e)

name: ChoppedPlane.columnGraded_ker_cofactor_eq_range
statement:
theorem columnGraded_ker_cofactor_eq_range
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K n)) (ε : Fin c → ℕ)
    (hB : ∀ i j, (B i j).IsHomogeneous (ε j))
    (hprimitive : PrimitiveMaximalMinors B) (e : ℤ) :
    (columnGradedCofactorMap B ε hB e).ker = (columnGradedMatrixMap B ε hB e).range

name: ChoppedPlane.columnMinorIdealPiece_finrank
statement:
theorem columnMinorIdealPiece_finrank
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K 3)) (ε : Fin c → ℕ)
    (hB : ∀ i j, (B i j).IsHomogeneous (ε j))
    (hprimitive : PrimitiveMaximalMinors B) (e : ℤ) :
    (finrank K (columnMinorIdealPiece B ε e) : ℤ) =
      ((c : ℤ) + 1) * N₂ e - ∑ j, N₂ (e - ε j)

name: ChoppedPlane.columnMinorQuotient_finrank
statement:
theorem columnMinorQuotient_finrank
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K 3)) (ε : Fin c → ℕ)
    (hB : ∀ i j, (B i j).IsHomogeneous (ε j))
    (hprimitive : PrimitiveMaximalMinors B) (e : ℤ) :
    (finrank K ((signedForms K 3 (e + ∑ j, ε j)) ⧸ columnMinorIdealPiece B ε e) : ℤ) =
      N₂ (e + ∑ j, ε j) - ((c : ℤ) + 1) * N₂ e + ∑ j, N₂ (e - ε j)

name: ChoppedPlane.determinant_homogeneous_columns
statement:
theorem determinant_homogeneous_columns {m : ℕ}
    (B : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) (Poly K n)) (ε : Fin m → ℕ)
    (hB : ∀ i j, (B i j).IsHomogeneous (ε j)) :
    B.det.IsHomogeneous (∑ j, ε j)

name: ChoppedPlane.finrank_columnPlaneForms
statement:
theorem finrank_columnPlaneForms (ε : Fin c → ℕ) (e : ℤ) :
    (finrank K (columnForms K 3 ε e) : ℤ) = ∑ j, N₂ (e - ε j)

name: ChoppedPlane.generatedHilbertFunction_columns_formula
statement:
theorem generatedHilbertFunction_columns_formula
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K 3)) (ε : Fin c → ℕ)
    (hB : ∀ i j, (B i j).IsHomogeneous (ε j))
    (hprimitive : PrimitiveMaximalMinors B) (t : ℕ) :
    (generatedHilbertFunction (minorGeneratorSpace B) t : ℤ) = N₂ t -
      ((c : ℤ) + 1) * N₂ ((t : ℤ) - ∑ j, ε j) +
      ∑ j, N₂ ((t : ℤ) - (∑ k, ε k) - ε j)

name: ChoppedPlane.generatedHilbertFunction_minorGeneratorSpace
statement:
theorem generatedHilbertFunction_minorGeneratorSpace
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K n)) (t : ℕ) :
    generatedHilbertFunction (minorGeneratorSpace B) t = minorHilbertFunction B t

name: ChoppedPlane.maximalMinor_homogeneous_columns
statement:
theorem maximalMinor_homogeneous_columns
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K n)) (ε : Fin c → ℕ)
    (hB : ∀ i j, (B i j).IsHomogeneous (ε j)) (i : Fin (c + 1)) :
    (maximalMinor B i).IsHomogeneous (∑ j, ε j)

name: ChoppedPlane.minorFormToRingQuotient_ker_columns
statement:
theorem minorFormToRingQuotient_ker_columns
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K n)) (ε : Fin c → ℕ) (e : ℤ) :
    (minorFormToRingQuotient B (e + ∑ j, ε j)).ker = columnMinorIdealPiece B ε e

name: ChoppedPlane.minorGeneratorSpace_homogeneous_columns
statement:
theorem minorGeneratorSpace_homogeneous_columns
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K n)) (ε : Fin c → ℕ)
    (hB : ∀ i j, (B i j).IsHomogeneous (ε j)) :
    minorGeneratorSpace B ≤ Forms K n (∑ j, ε j)

name: ChoppedPlane.minorGeneratorSpace_idealSpan
statement:
theorem minorGeneratorSpace_idealSpan
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K n)) :
    Ideal.span (minorGeneratorSpace B : Set (Poly K n)) = maximalMinorIdeal B

name: ChoppedPlane.minorHilbertFunction_columns_at_degree
statement:
theorem minorHilbertFunction_columns_at_degree
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K 3)) (ε : Fin c → ℕ)
    (hB : ∀ i j, (B i j).IsHomogeneous (ε j))
    (hprimitive : PrimitiveMaximalMinors B) (t : ℤ) :
    (minorHilbertFunction B t : ℤ) = N₂ t - ((c : ℤ) + 1) * N₂ (t - ∑ j, ε j) +
      ∑ j, N₂ (t - (∑ k, ε k) - ε j)

name: ChoppedPlane.minorHilbertFunction_columns_formula
statement:
theorem minorHilbertFunction_columns_formula
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K 3)) (ε : Fin c → ℕ)
    (hB : ∀ i j, (B i j).IsHomogeneous (ε j))
    (hprimitive : PrimitiveMaximalMinors B) (e : ℤ) :
    (minorHilbertFunction B (e + ∑ j, ε j) : ℤ) =
      N₂ (e + ∑ j, ε j) - ((c : ℤ) + 1) * N₂ e + ∑ j, N₂ (e - ε j)

name: ChoppedPlane.signedComponent_cofactorMap_columns
statement:
theorem signedComponent_cofactorMap_columns
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K n)) (ε : Fin c → ℕ)
    (hB : ∀ i j, (B i j).IsHomogeneous (ε j))
    (e : ℤ) (v : Fin (c + 1) → Poly K n) :
    signedComponent (e + ∑ j, ε j) (cofactorMap B v) =
      cofactorMap B (signedVectorVal (signedVectorComponent (c + 1) e v))

name: ChoppedPlane.signedComponent_mulVec_columns
statement:
theorem signedComponent_mulVec_columns
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K n)) (ε : Fin c → ℕ)
    (hB : ∀ i j, (B i j).IsHomogeneous (ε j))
    (e : ℤ) (w : Fin c → Poly K n) (i : Fin (c + 1)) :
    signedComponent e (B.mulVec w i) =
      B.mulVec (columnFormsVal (columnFormsComponent ε e w)) i

name: ChoppedPlane.signedMaximalMinor_homogeneous_columns
statement:
theorem signedMaximalMinor_homogeneous_columns
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K n)) (ε : Fin c → ℕ)
    (hB : ∀ i j, (B i j).IsHomogeneous (ε j)) (i : Fin (c + 1)) :
    (signedMaximalMinor B i).IsHomogeneous (∑ j, ε j)

name: ChoppedPlane.signedVectorComponent_self
statement:
@[simp] theorem signedVectorComponent_self (m : ℕ) (e : ℤ)
    (v : Fin m → signedForms K n e) :
    signedVectorComponent m e (signedVectorVal v) = v

name: ChoppedPlane.ferrersDeletedRow_after
statement:
theorem ferrersDeletedRow_after (f g : Fin (c + 1) → R) (k : Fin (c + 1))
    (i j : Fin c) (hi : ¬i.val < k.val) :
    ferrersDeletedRow f g k i j =
      if i.val + 1 = j.val then f i.succ else if i.val = j.val then g i.succ else 0

name: ChoppedPlane.ferrersDeletedRow_before
statement:
theorem ferrersDeletedRow_before (f g : Fin (c + 1) → R) (k : Fin (c + 1))
    (i j : Fin c) (hi : i.val < k.val) :
    ferrersDeletedRow f g k i j =
      if i.val = j.val then f i.castSucc else if i.val = j.val + 1 then g i.castSucc else 0

name: ChoppedPlane.ferrersDeletedRow_det
statement:
theorem ferrersDeletedRow_det (f g : Fin (c + 1) → R) (k : Fin (c + 1)) :
    (ferrersDeletedRow f g k).det =
      (∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin (c + 1) => i.val < k.val), f i) *
      (∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin (c + 1) => k.val < i.val), g i)

name: ChoppedPlane.ferrersDeletedRow_det_subtype
statement:
theorem ferrersDeletedRow_det_subtype (f g : Fin (c + 1) → R) (k : Fin (c + 1)) :
    (ferrersDeletedRow f g k).det =
      (∏ i : {i : Fin c // i.val < k.val}, f i.val.castSucc) *
      (∏ i : {i : Fin c // ¬i.val < k.val}, g i.val.succ)

name: ChoppedPlane.ferrersSignedCofactor_eq
statement:
theorem ferrersSignedCofactor_eq (f g : Fin (c + 1) → R) (k : Fin (c + 1)) :
    ferrersSignedCofactor f g k = (-1) ^ k.val *
      ((∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin (c + 1) => i.val < k.val), f i) *
       (∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin (c + 1) => k.val < i.val), g i))

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.dehom_eval
statement:
@[simp] theorem dehom_eval (P : Poly K 3) (a b : K) :
    (dehom P).evalEval a b = MvPolynomial.eval ![a,b,1] P

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.dehom_first
statement:
@[simp] theorem dehom_first {d : ℕ} (α : Fin d → K) :
    dehom (planeFirst α) = firstEquation α

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.dehom_injective
statement:
theorem dehom_injective [Infinite K] {d : ℕ} :
    Function.Injective (fun f : Forms K 3 d => dehom f.val)

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.dehom_second
statement:
@[simp] theorem dehom_second {d : ℕ} (β : Fin d → K) :
    dehom (planeSecond β) = secondEquation β

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.dehom_smul
statement:
@[simp] theorem dehom_smul (c : K) (P : Poly K 3) :
    dehom (c • P) = c • dehom P

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.first_linear_irreducible
statement:
theorem first_linear_irreducible (a : K) :
    Irreducible (X 0 - C a * X 2 : Poly K 3)

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.grid_forms_kernel
statement:
theorem grid_forms_kernel [Infinite K] {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (α β : Fin d → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β) (f : Forms K 3 d) :
    (∀ i j, MvPolynomial.eval ![α i,β j,1] f.val = 0) ↔
      ∃ a b : K, f = a • firstForm α + b • secondForm β

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.planeFirst_eval
statement:
@[simp] theorem planeFirst_eval {d : ℕ} (α : Fin d → K) (a b : K) :
    eval ![a,b,1] (planeFirst α) = (coordinatePolynomial α).eval a

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.planeFirst_eval_infinity
statement:
@[simp] theorem planeFirst_eval_infinity {d : ℕ} (α : Fin d → K) :
    eval ![1,0,0] (planeFirst α) = 1

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.planeFirst_homogeneous
statement:
theorem planeFirst_homogeneous {d : ℕ} (α : Fin d → K) :
    (planeFirst α).IsHomogeneous d

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.planeFirst_ne_zero
statement: theorem planeFirst_ne_zero {d : ℕ} (α : Fin d → K) : planeFirst α ≠ 0

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.planeSecond_eval
statement:
@[simp] theorem planeSecond_eval {d : ℕ} (β : Fin d → K) (a b : K) :
    eval ![a,b,1] (planeSecond β) = (coordinatePolynomial β).eval b

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.planeSecond_eval_infinity
statement:
@[simp] theorem planeSecond_eval_infinity {d : ℕ} (β : Fin d → K) :

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.planeSecond_homogeneous
statement:
theorem planeSecond_homogeneous {d : ℕ} (β : Fin d → K) :

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.planeSecond_ne_zero
statement: theorem planeSecond_ne_zero {d : ℕ} (β : Fin d → K) : planeSecond β ≠ 0

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.plane_equations_relPrime
statement:
theorem plane_equations_relPrime {d : ℕ} (α β : Fin d → K) :

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.plane_regular_mod_first
statement:
theorem plane_regular_mod_first {d : ℕ} (α β : Fin d → K) (P : Poly K 3)

name: ChoppedPlane.affineDehom_X_one
statement: @[simp] theorem affineDehom_X_one : affineDehom (X 1 : Poly K 3) = X 1

name: ChoppedPlane.affineDehom_X_two
statement: @[simp] theorem affineDehom_X_two : affineDehom (X 2 : Poly K 3) = 1

name: ChoppedPlane.affineDehom_X_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem affineDehom_X_zero : affineDehom (X 0 : Poly K 3) = X 0

name: ChoppedPlane.affineDehom_comp_rename
statement:
theorem affineDehom_comp_rename :
    (affineDehom (K := K)).comp (MvPolynomial.rename (Fin.castSucc : Fin 2 → Fin 3)) =
      AlgHom.id K (Poly K 2)

name: ChoppedPlane.affineDehom_eq_iff
statement:
theorem affineDehom_eq_iff (f g : Poly K 3) :
    affineDehom f = affineDehom g ↔ (X 2 - 1 : Poly K 3) ∣ f - g

name: ChoppedPlane.affineDehom_ker
statement:
theorem affineDehom_ker : RingHom.ker (affineDehom (K := K)).toRingHom =
    Ideal.span {(X 2 : Poly K 3) - 1}

name: ChoppedPlane.affineDehom_rename
statement:
@[simp] theorem affineDehom_rename (p : Poly K 2) :
    affineDehom (MvPolynomial.rename (Fin.castSucc : Fin 2 → Fin 3) p) = p

name: ChoppedPlane.affineDehom_surjective
statement: theorem affineDehom_surjective : Function.Surjective (affineDehom (K := K))

name: ChoppedPlane.affineDehom_mem_map_iff
statement:
theorem affineDehom_mem_map_iff
    (I : Ideal (Poly K 3))
    (hI : I.IsHomogeneous (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 3) K))
    (hsat : ∀ p, (X 2 : Poly K 3) * p ∈ I → p ∈ I)
    {t : ℕ} {f : Poly K 3} (hf : f.IsHomogeneous t) :
    affineDehom f ∈ I.map (affineDehom (K := K)).toRingHom ↔ f ∈ I

name: ChoppedPlane.homogeneousComponent_mul_degree_one_succ
statement:
theorem homogeneousComponent_mul_degree_one_succ
    {z : MvPolynomial σ K} (hz : z.IsHomogeneous 1)
    (n : ℕ) (g : MvPolynomial σ K) :
    homogeneousComponent (n + 1) (z * g) = z * homogeneousComponent n g

name: ChoppedPlane.homogeneousComponent_mul_degree_one_zero
statement:
theorem homogeneousComponent_mul_degree_one_zero
    {z : MvPolynomial σ K} (hz : z.IsHomogeneous 1)

name: ChoppedPlane.homogeneous_mem_of_sub_coordinate_one_mul
statement:
theorem homogeneous_mem_of_sub_coordinate_one_mul
    (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ K))

    {z : MvPolynomial σ K} (hz : z.IsHomogeneous 1)

    {t : ℕ} {f : MvPolynomial σ K} (hf : f.IsHomogeneous t)

name: ChoppedPlane.cofactorIdeal_eq_span_maximalMinor
statement:
theorem cofactorIdeal_eq_span_maximalMinor
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) R) :

name: ChoppedPlane.mem_cofactorIdeal_iff
statement:
theorem mem_cofactorIdeal_iff (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) R) (p : R) :

name: ChoppedPlane.mem_cofactorIdeal_of_mul
statement:
theorem mem_cofactorIdeal_of_mul
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) R) (z : R) (hz : z ≠ 0)

    (hker : RingHom.ker φ = Ideal.span {z}) (hprimitive : PrimitiveMaximalMinors (B.map φ))
    (p : R) (hp : z * p ∈ cofactorIdeal B) : p ∈ cofactorIdeal B

name: ChoppedPlane.mul_mem_cofactorIdeal_iff
statement:
theorem mul_mem_cofactorIdeal_iff
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) R) (z : R) (hz : z ≠ 0)
    (φ : R →+* S) (hφ : Function.Surjective φ)
    (hker : RingHom.ker φ = Ideal.span {z}) (hprimitive : PrimitiveMaximalMinors (B.map φ))
    (p : R) : z * p ∈ cofactorIdeal B ↔ p ∈ cofactorIdeal B

name: ChoppedPlane.pow_mul_mem_cofactorIdeal_iff
statement:
theorem pow_mul_mem_cofactorIdeal_iff
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) R) (z : R) (hz : z ≠ 0)
    (φ : R →+* S) (hφ : Function.Surjective φ)
    (hker : RingHom.ker φ = Ideal.span {z}) (hprimitive : PrimitiveMaximalMinors (B.map φ))
    (n : ℕ) (p : R) : z ^ n * p ∈ cofactorIdeal B ↔ p ∈ cofactorIdeal B

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.affineCofactorIdeal_quotient_reduced
statement:
theorem affineCofactorIdeal_quotient_reduced {c : ℕ} (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ)
    (α β : RootIndex δ → K) (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β) :
    IsReduced (Poly K 2 ⧸ affineCofactorIdeal δ α β)

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.affineCofactor_separator
statement:
theorem affineCofactor_separator {c : ℕ} (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ)
    (α β : RootIndex δ → K) (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β)
    (ij : Fin (Fintype.card (RootIndex δ)) × Fin (Fintype.card (RootIndex δ)))
    (hij : ij ∉ selectedGridSet δ) :
    ∃ f ∈ affineCofactorIdeal δ α β,
      Grid.mvAffineGridEvaluation (flatRoots δ α) (flatRoots δ β) f ij ≠ 0

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.binary_X_relPrime
statement: theorem binary_X_relPrime : IsRelPrime (X 0 : Poly K 2) (X 1)

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.canonicalRoots_injective
statement:
theorem canonicalRoots_injective [Infinite K] (δ : Fin m → ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (canonicalRoots (K := K) δ)

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.cofactorIdeal_eq_pointIdeal
statement:
theorem cofactorIdeal_eq_pointIdeal {c : ℕ} (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ)
    (α β : RootIndex δ → K) (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β) :
    cofactorIdeal δ α β = pointIdeal K (pointCoordinates δ α β)

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.cofactorIdeal_homogeneous
statement:
theorem cofactorIdeal_homogeneous (δ : Fin m → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex δ → K) :
    (cofactorIdeal δ α β).IsHomogeneous (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 3) K)

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.cofactorIdeal_le_pointIdeal
statement:
theorem cofactorIdeal_le_pointIdeal (δ : Fin m → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex δ → K) :
    cofactorIdeal δ α β ≤ pointIdeal K (pointCoordinates δ α β)

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.cofactorIdeal_z_saturated
statement:
theorem cofactorIdeal_z_saturated {c : ℕ} (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ)
    (α β : RootIndex δ → K) (n : ℕ) (p : Poly K 3) :
    X 2 ^ n * p ∈ cofactorIdeal δ α β ↔ p ∈ cofactorIdeal δ α β

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.cofactorProduct_eval_selected
statement:
theorem cofactorProduct_eval_selected (δ : Fin m → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex δ → K)
    (s : SelectedIndex δ) (k : Fin m) :
    eval ![selectedX δ α s, selectedY δ β s, 1] (cofactorProduct δ α β k) = 0

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.cofactorProduct_homogeneous
statement:
theorem cofactorProduct_homogeneous (δ : Fin m → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex δ → K)
    (j : Fin m) :
    (cofactorProduct δ α β j).IsHomogeneous
      ((∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i => i < j), δ i) +
       (∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i => j < i), δ i))

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.cofactorProduct_last
statement:
@[simp] theorem cofactorProduct_last {c : ℕ} (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ)
    (α β : RootIndex δ → K) :
    cofactorProduct δ α β (Fin.last c) =
      ∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin (c + 1) => i < Fin.last c), rowFirst δ α i

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.cofactorProduct_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem cofactorProduct_zero {c : ℕ} (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ)
    (α β : RootIndex δ → K) :
    cofactorProduct δ α β 0 =
      ∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin (c + 1) => 0 < i), rowSecond δ β i

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.cofactorProducts_vanish_iff_selected
statement:
theorem cofactorProducts_vanish_iff_selected (δ : Fin m → ℕ)
    (α β : RootIndex δ → K) (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β)
    (u v : RootIndex δ) :
    (∀ j, eval ![α u, β v, 1] (cofactorProduct δ α β j) = 0) ↔ u.1 < v.1

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.distinct_pointCoordinates
statement:
theorem distinct_pointCoordinates (δ : Fin m → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex δ → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β) :
    DistinctPoints K (pointCoordinates δ α β)

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.eval_affineDehom
statement:
theorem eval_affineDehom (f : Poly K 3) (x y : K) :
    eval ![x,y] (affineDehom f) = eval ![x,y,1] f

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.firstProducts_relPrime_secondProducts
statement:
theorem firstProducts_relPrime_secondProducts (δ : Fin m → ℕ)
    (α β : RootIndex δ → K) (s t : Finset (Fin m)) :
    IsRelPrime (∏ i ∈ s, rowFirst δ α i) (∏ j ∈ t, rowSecond δ β j)

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.flatRoots_injective
statement:
theorem flatRoots_injective (δ : Fin m → ℕ) (α : RootIndex δ → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) : Function.Injective (flatRoots δ α)

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.homogeneous_mem_cofactorIdeal_of_pointIdeal
statement:
theorem homogeneous_mem_cofactorIdeal_of_pointIdeal {c t : ℕ}
    (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex δ → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β)
    (f : Forms K 3 t) (hf : f.val ∈ pointIdeal K (pointCoordinates δ α β)) :
    f.val ∈ cofactorIdeal δ α β

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.infinityMap_ker
statement: theorem infinityMap_ker : RingHom.ker (infinityMap (K := K)) = Ideal.span {X 2}

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.infinityMap_rowFirst
statement:
@[simp] theorem infinityMap_rowFirst {c : ℕ} (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ)
    (α : RootIndex δ → K) (i : Fin (c + 1)) :
    infinityMap (rowFirst δ α i) = (X 0 : Poly K 2) ^ δ i

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.infinityMap_rowSecond
statement:
@[simp] theorem infinityMap_rowSecond {c : ℕ} (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ)
    (β : RootIndex δ → K) (i : Fin (c + 1)) :
    infinityMap (rowSecond δ β i) = (X 1 : Poly K 2) ^ δ i

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.infinityMap_surjective
statement: theorem infinityMap_surjective : Function.Surjective (infinityMap (K := K))

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.mvAffineGridIdeal_le_affineCofactorIdeal
statement:
theorem mvAffineGridIdeal_le_affineCofactorIdeal {c : ℕ} (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ)

    Grid.mvAffineGridIdeal (flatRoots δ α) (flatRoots δ β) ≤ affineCofactorIdeal δ α β

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.pointCoordinates_first
statement:
@[simp] theorem pointCoordinates_first (δ : Fin m → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex δ → K)
    (i : Fin (Fintype.card (SelectedIndex δ))) :
    pointCoordinates δ α β (i, 0) =
      selectedX δ α ((Fintype.equivFin (SelectedIndex δ)).symm i)

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.pointCoordinates_second
statement:
@[simp] theorem pointCoordinates_second (δ : Fin m → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex δ → K)
    (i : Fin (Fintype.card (SelectedIndex δ))) :
    pointCoordinates δ α β (i, 1) =
      selectedY δ β ((Fintype.equivFin (SelectedIndex δ)).symm i)

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.pointIdeal_homogeneous
statement:
theorem pointIdeal_homogeneous {p : ℕ} (a : PointCoordinates K p) :

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.pureSeed_primitive
statement:
theorem pureSeed_primitive {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
    [UniqueFactorizationMonoid R] {c : ℕ} (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ)
    (x y : R) (hxy : IsRelPrime x y) :

      (ferrersBidiagonal (fun i => x ^ δ i) (fun i => y ^ δ i))

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.rowFirst_eval_ne_zero

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.rowFirst_eval_root
statement:

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.rowFirst_homogeneous
statement:
theorem rowFirst_homogeneous (δ : Fin m → ℕ) (α : RootIndex δ → K) (i : Fin m) :

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.rowSecond_eval_ne_zero

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.rowSecond_eval_root
statement:

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.rowSecond_homogeneous
statement:
theorem rowSecond_homogeneous (δ : Fin m → ℕ) (β : RootIndex δ → K) (i : Fin m) :
    (rowSecond δ β i).IsHomogeneous (δ i)

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.seedMatrix_cofactorIdeal
statement:
theorem seedMatrix_cofactorIdeal {c : ℕ} (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ)
    (α β : RootIndex δ → K) :
    ChoppedPlane.cofactorIdeal (seedMatrix δ α β) = cofactorIdeal δ α β

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.seedMatrix_deletedRow_det
statement:
theorem seedMatrix_deletedRow_det {c : ℕ} (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ)
    (α β : RootIndex δ → K) (j : Fin (c + 1)) :
    (seedMatrix δ α β |>.submatrix j.succAbove id).det = cofactorProduct δ α β j

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.seedMatrix_homogeneous
statement:
theorem seedMatrix_homogeneous {c : ℕ} (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ)
    (α β : RootIndex δ → K) (i : Fin (c + 1)) (j : Fin c) :
    (seedMatrix δ α β i j).IsHomogeneous (δ i)

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.seedMatrix_map_infinity
statement:
theorem seedMatrix_map_infinity {c : ℕ} (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ)
    (α β : RootIndex δ → K) :
    (seedMatrix δ α β).map infinityMap =
      ferrersBidiagonal (fun i => (X 0 : Poly K 2) ^ δ i)
        (fun i => (X 1 : Poly K 2) ^ δ i)

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.seedMatrix_primitive
statement:
theorem seedMatrix_primitive {c : ℕ} (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ)
    (α β : RootIndex δ → K) : PrimitiveMaximalMinors (seedMatrix δ α β)

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.seedMatrix_primitive_atInfinity
statement:
theorem seedMatrix_primitive_atInfinity {c : ℕ} (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ)

    PrimitiveMaximalMinors ((seedMatrix δ α β).map infinityMap)

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.selected_card
statement:
theorem selected_card (δ : Fin m → ℕ) :
    Fintype.card (SelectedIndex δ) =
      ∑ ij : {ij : Fin m × Fin m // ij.1 < ij.2}, δ ij.val.1 * δ ij.val.2

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.selected_injective
statement:
theorem selected_injective (δ : Fin m → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex δ → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β) :
    Function.Injective (fun s : SelectedIndex δ => (selectedX δ α s, selectedY δ β s))

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.totalFirst_eq_planeFirst
statement:
theorem totalFirst_eq_planeFirst (δ : Fin m → ℕ) (α : RootIndex δ → K) :
    (∏ i, rowFirst δ α i) = Grid.planeFirst (flatRoots δ α)

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.totalFirst_mem
statement:
theorem totalFirst_mem {c : ℕ} (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ)
    (α β : RootIndex δ → K) :
    (∏ i, rowFirst δ α i) ∈ cofactorIdeal δ α β

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.totalSecond_eq_planeSecond
statement:
theorem totalSecond_eq_planeSecond (δ : Fin m → ℕ) (β : RootIndex δ → K) :
    (∏ i, rowSecond δ β i) = Grid.planeSecond (flatRoots δ β)

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.totalSecond_mem
statement:
theorem totalSecond_mem {c : ℕ} (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ)
    (α β : RootIndex δ → K) :
    (∏ i, rowSecond δ β i) ∈ cofactorIdeal δ α β

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.affineCofactorIdeal_quotient_reduced
statement:
theorem affineCofactorIdeal_quotient_reduced (ε : Fin c → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex ε → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β) :
    IsReduced (Poly K 2 ⧸ affineCofactorIdeal ε α β)

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.affineCofactor_separator
statement:
theorem affineCofactor_separator (ε : Fin c → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex ε → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β)
    (ij : Fin (Fintype.card (RootIndex ε)) × Fin (Fintype.card (RootIndex ε)))
    (hij : ij ∉ selectedGridSet ε) :
    ∃ f ∈ affineCofactorIdeal ε α β,
      Grid.mvAffineGridEvaluation (Ferrers.flatRoots ε α) (Ferrers.flatRoots ε β) f ij ≠ 0

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.bidiagonal_deletedRow_det
statement:
theorem bidiagonal_deletedRow_det {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (f g : Fin c → R)
    (k : Fin (c+1)) :
    ((bidiagonal f g).submatrix k.succAbove id).det =
      (∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun j => j.val < k.val), f j) *
      (∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun j => k.val ≤ j.val), g j)

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.cofactorIdeal_eq_pointIdeal
statement:
theorem cofactorIdeal_eq_pointIdeal (ε : Fin c → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex ε → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β) :
    cofactorIdeal ε α β = pointIdeal K (pointCoordinates ε α β)

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.cofactorIdeal_homogeneous
statement:
theorem cofactorIdeal_homogeneous (ε : Fin c → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex ε → K) :
    (cofactorIdeal ε α β).IsHomogeneous (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 3) K)

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.cofactorIdeal_le_pointIdeal
statement:
theorem cofactorIdeal_le_pointIdeal (ε : Fin c → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex ε → K) :
    cofactorIdeal ε α β ≤ pointIdeal K (pointCoordinates ε α β)

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.cofactorIdeal_z_saturated
statement:
theorem cofactorIdeal_z_saturated (ε : Fin c → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex ε → K)
    (n : ℕ) (p : Poly K 3) :
    X 2 ^ n * p ∈ cofactorIdeal ε α β ↔ p ∈ cofactorIdeal ε α β

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.cofactorProduct_eval_selected
statement:
theorem cofactorProduct_eval_selected (ε : Fin c → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex ε → K)
    (s : SelectedIndex ε) (k : Fin (c+1)) :
    eval ![selectedX ε α s,selectedY ε β s,1] (cofactorProduct ε α β k) = 0

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.cofactorProduct_homogeneous
statement:
theorem cofactorProduct_homogeneous (ε : Fin c → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex ε → K)
    (k : Fin (c+1)) : (cofactorProduct ε α β k).IsHomogeneous (∑ j, ε j)

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.cofactorProduct_last
statement:
@[simp] theorem cofactorProduct_last (ε : Fin c → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex ε → K) :
    cofactorProduct ε α β (Fin.last c) = ∏ j, Ferrers.rowFirst ε α j

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.cofactorProduct_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem cofactorProduct_zero (ε : Fin c → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex ε → K) :
    cofactorProduct ε α β 0 = ∏ j, Ferrers.rowSecond ε β j

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.cofactorProducts_vanish_iff_selected
statement:
theorem cofactorProducts_vanish_iff_selected (ε : Fin c → ℕ)
    (α β : RootIndex ε → K) (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β)
    (u v : RootIndex ε) :
    (∀ k, eval ![α u,β v,1] (cofactorProduct ε α β k) = 0) ↔ u.1 ≤ v.1

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.distinct_pointCoordinates
statement:
theorem distinct_pointCoordinates (ε : Fin c → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex ε → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β) :
    DistinctPoints K (pointCoordinates ε α β)

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.homogeneous_mem_cofactorIdeal_of_pointIdeal
statement:
theorem homogeneous_mem_cofactorIdeal_of_pointIdeal {t : ℕ}
    (ε : Fin c → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex ε → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β)
    (f : Forms K 3 t) (hf : f.val ∈ pointIdeal K (pointCoordinates ε α β)) :
    f.val ∈ cofactorIdeal ε α β

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.mvAffineGridIdeal_le_affineCofactorIdeal
statement:
theorem mvAffineGridIdeal_le_affineCofactorIdeal (ε : Fin c → ℕ)
    (α β : RootIndex ε → K) :
    Grid.mvAffineGridIdeal (Ferrers.flatRoots ε α) (Ferrers.flatRoots ε β) ≤

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.pointCoordinates_first
statement:
@[simp] theorem pointCoordinates_first (ε : Fin c → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex ε → K)
    (i : Fin (Fintype.card (SelectedIndex ε))) :
    pointCoordinates ε α β (i,0) = selectedX ε α ((Fintype.equivFin _).symm i)

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.pointCoordinates_second
statement:
@[simp] theorem pointCoordinates_second (ε : Fin c → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex ε → K)
    (i : Fin (Fintype.card (SelectedIndex ε))) :

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.pureSeed_primitive
statement:
theorem pureSeed_primitive {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
    [UniqueFactorizationMonoid R] (ε : Fin c → ℕ) (x y : R) (hxy : IsRelPrime x y) :

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.seedMatrix_cofactorIdeal
statement:
theorem seedMatrix_cofactorIdeal (ε : Fin c → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex ε → K) :

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.seedMatrix_deletedRow_det
statement:
theorem seedMatrix_deletedRow_det (ε : Fin c → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex ε → K)
    (k : Fin (c+1)) :
    ((seedMatrix ε α β).submatrix k.succAbove id).det = cofactorProduct ε α β k

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.seedMatrix_homogeneous
statement:
theorem seedMatrix_homogeneous (ε : Fin c → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex ε → K)
    (i : Fin (c+1)) (j : Fin c) : (seedMatrix ε α β i j).IsHomogeneous (ε j)

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.seedMatrix_map_infinity
statement:
theorem seedMatrix_map_infinity (ε : Fin c → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex ε → K) :
    (seedMatrix ε α β).map Ferrers.infinityMap =
      bidiagonal (fun j => (X 0 : Poly K 2)^ε j) (fun j => (X 1 : Poly K 2)^ε j)

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.seedMatrix_primitive
statement:
theorem seedMatrix_primitive (ε : Fin c → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex ε → K) :
    PrimitiveMaximalMinors (seedMatrix ε α β)

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.seedMatrix_primitive_atInfinity
statement:
theorem seedMatrix_primitive_atInfinity (ε : Fin c → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex ε → K) :
    PrimitiveMaximalMinors ((seedMatrix ε α β).map Ferrers.infinityMap)

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.selected_card
statement:
theorem selected_card (ε : Fin c → ℕ) :
    Fintype.card (SelectedIndex ε) =
      ∑ ij : {ij : Fin c × Fin c // ij.1 ≤ ij.2}, ε ij.val.1 * ε ij.val.2

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.selected_injective
statement:
theorem selected_injective (ε : Fin c → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex ε → K)
