name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.affineCofactorIdeal_le_selectedAffineEvaluation_ker
statement:
theorem affineCofactorIdeal_le_selectedAffineEvaluation_ker 
    (δ : Fin m → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex δ → K) :
    affineCofactorIdeal δ α β ≤ RingHom.ker (selectedAffineEvaluation δ α β).toRingHom

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.affineCofactorQuotient_finite
statement:
theorem affineCofactorQuotient_finite (δ : Fin m → ℕ)
    (α β : RootIndex δ → K) (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β) :
    Module.Finite K (Poly K 2 ⧸ affineCofactorIdeal δ α β)

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.affineCofactorQuotient_finrank
statement:
theorem affineCofactorQuotient_finrank (δ : Fin m → ℕ)
    (α β : RootIndex δ → K) (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β) :
    Module.finrank K (Poly K 2 ⧸ affineCofactorIdeal δ α β) = Fintype.card (SelectedIndex δ)

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.selectedAffineEvaluation_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem selectedAffineEvaluation_apply (δ : Fin m → ℕ)
    (α β : RootIndex δ → K) (f : Poly K 2) (s : SelectedIndex δ) :
    selectedAffineEvaluation δ α β f s = eval ![selectedX δ α s, selectedY δ β s] f

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.selectedAffineEvaluation_eq_full
statement:
theorem selectedAffineEvaluation_eq_full (δ : Fin m → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex δ → K)
    (f : Poly K 2) (s : SelectedIndex δ) :
    selectedAffineEvaluation δ α β f s =
      Grid.mvAffineGridEvaluation (Ferrers.flatRoots δ α) (Ferrers.flatRoots δ β) f (selectedGridIndex δ s)

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.selectedAffineEvaluation_ker
statement:
theorem selectedAffineEvaluation_ker (δ : Fin m → ℕ)
    (α β : RootIndex δ → K) (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β) :
    RingHom.ker (selectedAffineEvaluation δ α β).toRingHom = affineCofactorIdeal δ α β

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.selectedAffineEvaluation_surjective
statement:
theorem selectedAffineEvaluation_surjective (δ : Fin m → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex δ → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β) :
    Function.Surjective (selectedAffineEvaluation δ α β)

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.selectedGridIndex_injective
statement:
theorem selectedGridIndex_injective (δ : Fin m → ℕ) :

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.selectedGridIndex_mem
statement:

    selectedGridIndex δ s ∈ selectedGridSet δ

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.endpointProfile_first
statement:
theorem endpointProfile_first {r a : ℕ} (hr : 2 ≤ r) (i : Fin (r + a))
    (hi : i.val = 0) : endpointProfile r a i = 2

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.endpointProfile_last
statement:
theorem endpointProfile_last {r a : ℕ} (i : Fin (r + a)) (hi : i.val + 1 = r + a) :
    endpointProfile r a i = 2

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.endpointProfile_pos
statement:
theorem endpointProfile_pos (r a : ℕ) (i : Fin (r + a)) :
    0 < endpointProfile r a i

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.endpointProfile_selected_card
statement:
theorem endpointProfile_selected_card {d r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (h : 2 * r ≤ d + 2) :
    Fintype.card (SelectedIndex (endpointProfile r (d + 2 - 2 * r))) =
      (d + 2).choose 2 - r

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.endpointProfile_square_sum
statement:
theorem endpointProfile_square_sum (r a : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r) :
    (∑ i, endpointProfile r a i ^ 2) = 4 * r + a

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.endpointProfile_sum
statement:
theorem endpointProfile_sum (r a : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r) :
    (∑ i, endpointProfile r a i) = 2 * r + a

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.positiveProfile_pos
statement:
theorem positiveProfile_pos (r a : ℕ) (i : Fin (r + a)) :
    0 < positiveProfile r a i

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.positiveProfile_row_count
statement:
theorem positiveProfile_row_count {d r : ℕ} (h : 2 * r ≤ d + 2) :
    r + (d + 2 - 2 * r) = d + 2 - r

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.positiveProfile_selected_card
statement:
theorem positiveProfile_selected_card {d r : ℕ} (h : 2 * r ≤ d + 2) :
    Fintype.card (SelectedIndex (positiveProfile r (d + 2 - 2 * r))) =
      (d + 2).choose 2 - r

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.positiveProfile_square_sum
statement:
theorem positiveProfile_square_sum (r a : ℕ) :
    (∑ i, positiveProfile r a i ^ 2) = 4 * r + a

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.positiveProfile_sum
statement:
theorem positiveProfile_sum (r a : ℕ) :
    (∑ i, positiveProfile r a i) = 2 * r + a

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.selected_card_of_sums
statement:
theorem selected_card_of_sums (δ : Fin m → ℕ) (d r : ℕ)
    (hsum : (∑ i, δ i) = d + 2)
    (hsquares : (∑ i, δ i ^ 2) = d + 2 + 2 * r) :
    Fintype.card (SelectedIndex δ) = (d + 2).choose 2 - r

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.selected_card_square
statement:
theorem selected_card_square (δ : Fin m → ℕ) :
    (∑ i, δ i) ^ 2 = (∑ i, δ i ^ 2) + 2 * Fintype.card (SelectedIndex δ)

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.weightedPairs_square
statement:
theorem weightedPairs_square (δ : Fin m → ℕ) :
    (∑ i, δ i) ^ 2 = (∑ i, δ i ^ 2) + 2 * weightedPairs δ

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.columnProfile_pos
statement: theorem columnProfile_pos (c q : ℕ) (i : Fin c) : 0 < columnProfile c q i

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.columnProfile_selected_card
statement:
theorem columnProfile_selected_card {d r : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hupper : r ≤ d + 1)
    (hlower : d + 2 ≤ 2 * r) :
    Fintype.card (SelectedIndex (columnProfile (r - 1) (d + 1 - r))) =
      (d + 2).choose 2 - r

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.columnProfile_square_sum
statement:
theorem columnProfile_square_sum (c q : ℕ) (hq : q ≤ c) :
    (∑ i, columnProfile c q i ^ 2) = c + 3 * q

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.columnProfile_sum
statement:
theorem columnProfile_sum (c q : ℕ) (hq : q ≤ c) :
    (∑ i, columnProfile c q i) = c + q

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.selected_card_eq_diagonal_add_pairs
statement:
theorem selected_card_eq_diagonal_add_pairs (ε : Fin c → ℕ) :
    Fintype.card (SelectedIndex ε) = (∑ i, ε i ^ 2) + Ferrers.weightedPairs ε

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.selected_card_of_sums
statement:
theorem selected_card_of_sums (ε : Fin c → ℕ) (d r q : ℕ)
    (hsum : (∑ i, ε i) = d)
    (hsquares : (∑ i, ε i ^ 2) = d + 2 * q)
    (hq : q + r = d + 1) :
    Fintype.card (SelectedIndex ε) = (d + 2).choose 2 - r

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.selected_card_one_two
statement:
theorem selected_card_one_two (ε : Fin c → ℕ) (hε : ∀ j, ε j = 1 ∨ ε j = 2) :
    Fintype.card (SelectedIndex ε) = N (∑ j, ε j) - (c + 1)

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.selected_card_square
statement:
theorem selected_card_square (ε : Fin c → ℕ) :
    2 * Fintype.card (SelectedIndex ε) = (∑ i, ε i) ^ 2 + (∑ i, ε i ^ 2)

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.choppedHilbertFunction_eq_pointHilbertFunction
statement:
theorem choppedHilbertFunction_eq_pointHilbertFunction (ε : Fin c → ℕ)
    (α β : RootIndex ε → K) (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β)
    (t : ℕ) :
    choppedHilbertFunction (pointCoordinates ε α β) (∑ j, ε j) t =
      pointHilbertFunction K (pointCoordinates ε α β) t

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.choppedIdeal_eq_pointIdeal
statement:
theorem choppedIdeal_eq_pointIdeal (ε : Fin c → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex ε → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β) :
    choppedIdeal K (pointCoordinates ε α β) (∑ j, ε j) =
      pointIdeal K (pointCoordinates ε α β)

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.fullPointHilbertFunction
statement:
theorem fullPointHilbertFunction (ε : Fin c → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex ε → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β) (hε : ∀ j, 0 < ε j)
    (hcard : Fintype.card (SelectedIndex ε) = N (∑ j, ε j) - (c+1)) (t : ℕ) :
    pointHilbertFunction K (pointCoordinates ε α β) t =
      min (N t) (Fintype.card (SelectedIndex ε))

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.pointHilbertFunction_eq_minorHilbertFunction
statement:
theorem pointHilbertFunction_eq_minorHilbertFunction (ε : Fin c → ℕ)
    (α β : RootIndex ε → K) (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β)
    (t : ℕ) :
    pointHilbertFunction K (pointCoordinates ε α β) t =
      minorHilbertFunction (seedMatrix ε α β) (t : ℤ)

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.pointHilbertFunction_formula
statement:
theorem pointHilbertFunction_formula (ε : Fin c → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex ε → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β) (t : ℕ) :
    (pointHilbertFunction K (pointCoordinates ε α β) t : ℤ) = N₂ t -
      ((c : ℤ)+1) * N₂ ((t : ℤ) - ∑ j, ε j) +
      ∑ j, N₂ ((t : ℤ) - (∑ k, ε k) - ε j)

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.pointHilbertFunction_eq_minorHilbertFunction
statement:
theorem pointHilbertFunction_eq_minorHilbertFunction (δ : Fin (c+1) → ℕ)
    (α β : RootIndex δ → K) (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β)
    (t : ℕ) :
    pointHilbertFunction K (pointCoordinates δ α β) t =
      minorHilbertFunction (seedMatrix δ α β) (t : ℤ)

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.pointHilbertFunction_formula
statement:
theorem pointHilbertFunction_formula (δ : Fin (c+1) → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex δ → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β) (t : ℕ) :
    (pointHilbertFunction K (pointCoordinates δ α β) t : ℤ) = N₂ t -
      (∑ i, N₂ ((t : ℤ) - (∑ j, δ j) + δ i)) +
      (c : ℤ) * N₂ ((t : ℤ) - ∑ i, δ i)

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.canonicalColumnCoordinates_properties
statement:
theorem canonicalColumnCoordinates_properties {d r : ℕ}
    (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hupper : r ≤ d + 1) (hlower : d + 2 ≤ 2 * r) :
    DistinctPoints K (canonicalColumnCoordinates (K := K) d r) ∧
    Function.Surjective (pointEvaluation K (canonicalColumnCoordinates (K := K) d r) d) ∧
    choppedIdeal K (canonicalColumnCoordinates (K := K) d r) d =
      pointIdeal K (canonicalColumnCoordinates (K := K) d r) ∧
    (∀ t, pointHilbertFunction K (canonicalColumnCoordinates (K := K) d r) t =
      min (N t) (N d - r)) ∧
    (∀ t, choppedHilbertFunction (canonicalColumnCoordinates (K := K) d r) d t =
      min (N t) (N d - r))

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.columnSeedCoordinates_properties
statement:
theorem columnSeedCoordinates_properties {d r : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (hupper : r ≤ d + 1) (hlower : d + 2 ≤ 2 * r) :
    DistinctPoints K (columnSeedCoordinates (K := K) d r hr hupper hlower) ∧
    Function.Surjective (pointEvaluation K (columnSeedCoordinates (K := K) d r hr hupper hlower) d) ∧
    choppedIdeal K (columnSeedCoordinates (K := K) d r hr hupper hlower) d =
      pointIdeal K (columnSeedCoordinates (K := K) d r hr hupper hlower) ∧
    (∀ t, pointHilbertFunction K (columnSeedCoordinates (K := K) d r hr hupper hlower) t =
      min (N t) (N d - r)) ∧
    (∀ t, choppedHilbertFunction (columnSeedCoordinates (K := K) d r hr hupper hlower) d t =
      min (N t) (N d - r))

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.exists_columnSeedWitness
statement:
theorem exists_columnSeedWitness {d r : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (hupper : r ≤ d + 1) (hlower : d + 2 ≤ 2 * r) :
    ∃ a : PointCoordinates K (N d - r), DistinctPoints K a ∧
      Function.Surjective (pointEvaluation K a d) ∧
      choppedIdeal K a d = pointIdeal K a ∧
      (∀ t, pointHilbertFunction K a t = min (N t) (N d - r)) ∧
      (∀ t, choppedHilbertFunction a d t = min (N t) (N d - r))

name: ChoppedPlane.ConcreteCech.overlap_preimage_of_cross
statement:
theorem overlap_preimage_of_cross
    (g : ι → ℤ) (h : κ → ℤ) (j : η → ℤ) (a b c : ℤ)
    (L : FreeLaurent K ι →ₗ[K] FreeLaurent K κ)
    (Q : FreeLaurent K κ →ₗ[K] FreeLaurent K η)
    (D : FreeLaurent K η →ₗ[K] N)
    (hQU : ∀ p ∈ uChartGrade h b, Q p ∈ uChartGrade j c)
    (hQV : ∀ p ∈ vChartGrade h b, Q p ∈ vChartGrade j c)
    (hQL : ∀ p, Q (L p) = 0)
    (hDQ : ∀ p, D (Q p) = 0)
    (hLinj : ∀ p ∈ overlapGrade g a, L p = 0 → p = 0)
    (hglobal : ∀ p ∈ positiveGrade j c, D p = 0 → p = 0)
    (hlocalU : ∀ p ∈ uChartGrade h b, Q p = 0 →
      ∃ x ∈ uChartGrade g a, L x = p)
    (hlocalV : ∀ p ∈ vChartGrade h b, Q p = 0 →
      ∃ x ∈ vChartGrade g a, L x = p)
    (p : FreeLaurent K ι) (hp : p ∈ overlapGrade g a)
    (hLp : L p ∈ uChartGrade h b ⊔ vChartGrade h b) :
    p ∈ uChartGrade g a ⊔ vChartGrade g a

statement:
theorem topMap_injective_of_cross
    (g : ι → ℤ) (h : κ → ℤ) (j : η → ℤ) (a b c : ℤ)
    (L : FreeLaurent K ι →ₗ[K] FreeLaurent K κ)
    (Q : FreeLaurent K κ →ₗ[K] FreeLaurent K η)
    (D : FreeLaurent K η →ₗ[K] N)
    (hL : ∀ p ∈ overlapGrade g a, L p ∈ overlapGrade h b)
    (hQU : ∀ p ∈ uChartGrade h b, Q p ∈ uChartGrade j c)
    (hQV : ∀ p ∈ vChartGrade h b, Q p ∈ vChartGrade j c)
    (hQL : ∀ p, Q (L p) = 0)
    (hDQ : ∀ p, D (Q p) = 0)
    (hLinj : ∀ p ∈ overlapGrade g a, L p = 0 → p = 0)
    (hglobal : ∀ p ∈ positiveGrade j c, D p = 0 → p = 0)
    (hlocalU : ∀ p ∈ uChartGrade h b, Q p = 0 →
      ∃ x ∈ uChartGrade g a, L x = p)
    (hlocalV : ∀ p ∈ vChartGrade h b, Q p = 0 →
      ∃ x ∈ vChartGrade g a, L x = p) :
    Function.Injective (topMap g h a b L hL)

name: ChoppedPlane.free_coefficients_coprime_descent
statement:
theorem free_coefficients_coprime_descent {ι : Type*} (x : ι → F) (u v : R)
    (huv : IsRelPrime u v)
    (h : ∀ i, (∃ m, IsInteger R (algebraMap R F (u ^ m) * x i)) ∧
      (∃ n, IsInteger R (algebraMap R F (v ^ n) * x i))) :
    ∃ y : ι → R, ∀ i, algebraMap R F (y i) = x i

name: ChoppedPlane.isInteger_of_coprime_integer_multiples
statement:
theorem isInteger_of_coprime_integer_multiples (x : F) (u v : R)

theorem finrank_idealFormQuotient {n : ℕ} (I : Ideal (Poly K n)) (t : ℕ) :
    finrank K (Forms K n t ⧸ idealFormPiece I t) =
      idealQuotientHilbertFunction I t

name: ChoppedPlane.finrank_nested_quotient_int
statement:
theorem finrank_nested_quotient_int {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [Module.Finite K V] (J I : Submodule K V) (hJI : J ≤ I) :
    (finrank K (I ⧸ J.comap I.subtype) : ℤ) =
      (finrank K I : ℤ) - (finrank K J : ℤ)

name: ChoppedPlane.finrank_quotient_eq_quotient_add_nested
statement:
theorem finrank_quotient_eq_quotient_add_nested {V : Type*}
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [Module.Finite K V]
    (J I : Submodule K V) (hJI : J ≤ I) :
    finrank K (V ⧸ J) = finrank K (V ⧸ I) +
      finrank K (I ⧸ J.comap I.subtype)

name: ChoppedPlane.finrank_quotient_eq_quotient_add_nested_int
statement:
theorem finrank_quotient_eq_quotient_add_nested_int {V : Type*}
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [Module.Finite K V]
    (J I : Submodule K V) (hJI : J ≤ I) :
    (finrank K (V ⧸ J) : ℤ) = (finrank K (V ⧸ I) : ℤ) +
      (finrank K (I ⧸ J.comap I.subtype) : ℤ)

name: ChoppedPlane.idealFormPiece_choppedIdeal_add

name: ChoppedPlane.idealQuotientHilbertFunction_eq_add_residual
statement:
theorem idealQuotientHilbertFunction_eq_add_residual {n : ℕ}
    (J I : Ideal (Poly K n)) (hJI : J ≤ I) (t : ℕ) :
    idealQuotientHilbertFunction J t = idealQuotientHilbertFunction I t +

    (idealQuotientHilbertFunction J t : ℤ) =
      (idealQuotientHilbertFunction I t : ℤ) +
      (finrank K (idealResidualPiece J I t) : ℤ)

theorem affineFormMap_surjective (I : Ideal (Poly K 3))

name: ChoppedPlane.affineFormQuotientEquiv_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem affineFormQuotientEquiv_mk (I : Ideal (Poly K 3))
    (hI : I.IsHomogeneous (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 3) K))
    (hsat : ∀ p, (X 2 : Poly K 3) * p ∈ I → p ∈ I) (N : ℕ)
    (hcut : ∀ f : Forms K 3 N, f.val ∈ I ⊔ Ideal.span {X (R := K) 2})
    (f : Forms K 3 N) :
    affineFormQuotientEquiv I hI hsat N hcut ((idealFormPiece I N).mkQ f) =
      affineQuotientMap I f.val

name: ChoppedPlane.affineQuotientMap_apply

name: ChoppedPlane.finrank_affineCoordinateAlgebra
statement:
theorem finrank_affineCoordinateAlgebra (I : Ideal (Poly K 3))

name: ChoppedPlane.formChartQuotientEquiv_mk

@[simp] theorem formChartQuotientEquiv_mk (π : Poly K 3 →ₐ[K] A)

name: ChoppedPlane.before_criticalTwist_source_le_target

theorem before_criticalTwist_source_le_target (K : Type*) [Field K] {a c : ℕ}
    (hac : a < c) (hpos : 0 < linearMatrixCriticalTwist a c) :
    finrank K (MatrixSource K c (linearMatrixCriticalTwist a c - 1)) ≤

name: ChoppedPlane.finrank_linearMatrixCokernel
statement:
theorem finrank_linearMatrixCokernel (L : LinearMatrix K a c) (t : ℕ)
    (h : LinearMatrixMaximalRank L t) :
    finrank K (LinearMatrixCokernel L t) =

name: ChoppedPlane.finrank_matrixSource

theorem finrank_matrixSource (K : Type*) [Field K] (c t : ℕ) :

name: ChoppedPlane.finrank_matrixTarget

theorem factorialWeight_add_single_comm (K : Type*) [CommSemiring K]

name: ChoppedPlane.factorialWeight_mul_coeff_pderiv

theorem factorialWeight_mul_coeff_pderiv (K : Type*) [CommSemiring K]
    (s : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) (i : Fin 3) (f : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) K) :
    factorialWeight K s * (pderiv i f).coeff s =
      factorialWeight K (s + Finsupp.single i 1) *
        f.coeff (s + Finsupp.single i 1)

name: ChoppedPlane.factorialWeight_ne_zero
statement:
theorem factorialWeight_ne_zero (K : Type*) [CommSemiring K] [CharZero K]

name: ChoppedPlane.factorialWeight_pderiv_monomial_pair

theorem factorialWeight_pderiv_monomial_pair (K : Type*) [CommSemiring K]

    factorialWeight K s *
        (pderiv i (monomial b 1 : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) K)).coeff s =
      factorialWeight K b *
        (X i * monomial s 1 : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) K).coeff b

name: ChoppedPlane.factorialWeight_zero

name: ChoppedPlane.operatorDifferential_apply
statement:
theorem operatorDifferential_apply (T : Fin 3 → V →ₗ[K] W) (t : ℕ)
    (x : Sym (Fin 3) (t + 1) → V) (s : Sym (Fin 3) t) :
    operatorDifferential T t x s = ∑ i : Fin 3,
      (((homogeneousTensorExponent t s) i + 1 : ℕ) : K) •
        T i (x (operatorRaisedIndex t s i))

name: ChoppedPlane.operatorDifferential_coeff
statement:
@[simp] theorem operatorDifferential_coeff (T : Fin 3 → V →ₗ[K] W) (t : ℕ)
    (x : Sym (Fin 3) (t + 1) → V) (s : Sym (Fin 3) t) :
    operatorDifferential T t x s = ∑ b : Sym (Fin 3) (t + 1), ∑ i : Fin 3,
      (pderiv i (monomial (homogeneousTensorExponent (t + 1) b) 1 : Poly K 3)).coeff
          (homogeneousTensorExponent t s) • T i (x b)

name: ChoppedPlane.operatorDifferential_injective_iff_linearMatrixMap_surjective
statement:
theorem operatorDifferential_injective_iff_linearMatrixMap_surjective [CharZero K]
    (bV : Basis (Fin a) K V) (bW : Basis (Fin c) K W)
    (T : Fin 3 → V →ₗ[K] W) (t : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (operatorDifferential T t) ↔
      Function.Surjective (linearMatrixMap (operatorLinearMatrix bV bW T) t)

name: ChoppedPlane.operatorDifferential_single
statement:
@[simp] theorem operatorDifferential_single (T : Fin 3 → V →ₗ[K] W) (t : ℕ)
    (b : Sym (Fin 3) (t + 1)) (v : V) (s : Sym (Fin 3) t) :
    operatorDifferential T t (Pi.single b v) s = ∑ i : Fin 3,
      (pderiv i (monomial (homogeneousTensorExponent (t + 1) b) 1 : Poly K 3)).coeff
        (homogeneousTensorExponent t s) • T i v

name: ChoppedPlane.operatorDifferential_single_repr
statement:
@[simp] theorem operatorDifferential_single_repr (bW : Basis (Fin c) K W)
    (T : Fin 3 → V →ₗ[K] W) (t : ℕ) (b : Sym (Fin 3) (t + 1))
    (v : V) (s : Sym (Fin 3) t) (j : Fin c) :
    bW.repr (operatorDifferential T t (Pi.single b v) s) j = ∑ i : Fin 3,
      (pderiv i (monomial (homogeneousTensorExponent (t + 1) b) 1 : Poly K 3)).coeff
        (homogeneousTensorExponent t s) * bW.repr (T i v) j

name: ChoppedPlane.operatorDifferential_surjective_iff_linearMatrixMap_injective
statement:
theorem operatorDifferential_surjective_iff_linearMatrixMap_injective [CharZero K]
    (bV : Basis (Fin a) K V) (bW : Basis (Fin c) K W)
    (T : Fin 3 → V →ₗ[K] W) (t : ℕ) :
    Function.Surjective (operatorDifferential T t) ↔
      Function.Injective (linearMatrixMap (operatorLinearMatrix bV bW T) t)

name: ChoppedPlane.operatorFactorialDualMap_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem operatorFactorialDualMap_apply (b : Basis (Fin a) K V) (n : ℕ)
    (x : Sym (Fin 3) n → V) (g : Fin a → Forms K 3 n) :
    operatorFactorialDualMap b n x g = ∑ s : Sym (Fin 3) n, ∑ k : Fin a,
      factorialWeight K (homogeneousTensorExponent n s) * b.repr (x s) k *
        (g k).val.coeff (homogeneousTensorExponent n s)

name: ChoppedPlane.operatorFactorialDualMap_injective
statement:
theorem operatorFactorialDualMap_injective [CharZero K]
    (b : Basis (Fin a) K V) (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (operatorFactorialDualMap b n)

name: ChoppedPlane.operatorFactorialDualMap_single_basis
statement:
@[simp] theorem operatorFactorialDualMap_single_basis
    (b : Basis (Fin a) K V) (n : ℕ) (x : Sym (Fin 3) n → V)
    (k : Fin a) (s : Sym (Fin 3) n) :
    operatorFactorialDualMap b n x (Pi.single k (formsBasis K 3 n s)) =
      factorialWeight K (homogeneousTensorExponent n s) * b.repr (x s) k

name: ChoppedPlane.operatorFactorialDualMap_single_module_basis
statement:
@[simp] theorem operatorFactorialDualMap_single_module_basis
    (b : Basis (Fin a) K V) (n : ℕ) (s : Sym (Fin 3) n)
    (k : Fin a) (g : Fin a → Forms K 3 n) :
    operatorFactorialDualMap b n (Pi.single s (b k)) g =
      factorialWeight K (homogeneousTensorExponent n s) *
        (g k).val.coeff (homogeneousTensorExponent n s)

name: ChoppedPlane.operatorFactorialDual_adjoint
statement:
theorem operatorFactorialDual_adjoint [CharZero K]
    (bV : Basis (Fin a) K V) (bW : Basis (Fin c) K W)
    (T : Fin 3 → V →ₗ[K] W) (t : ℕ) :
    (operatorFactorialDual bW t).toLinearMap.comp (operatorDifferential T t) =
      (linearMatrixMap (operatorLinearMatrix bV bW T) t).dualMap.comp
        (operatorFactorialDual bV (t + 1)).toLinearMap

name: ChoppedPlane.operatorFactorialDual_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem operatorFactorialDual_apply [CharZero K] (b : Basis (Fin a) K V)
    (n : ℕ) (x : Sym (Fin 3) n → V) :
    operatorFactorialDual b n x = operatorFactorialDualMap b n x

name: ChoppedPlane.operatorLinearMatrix_mul_single_coeff
statement:
theorem operatorLinearMatrix_mul_single_coeff
    (bV : Basis (Fin a) K V) (bW : Basis (Fin c) K W)
    (T : Fin 3 → V →ₗ[K] W) (t : ℕ) (j : Fin c) (s : Sym (Fin 3) t)
    (k : Fin a) (b : Sym (Fin 3) (t + 1)) :
    (linearMatrixMap (operatorLinearMatrix bV bW T) t
      (Pi.single j (formsBasis K 3 t s)) k).val.coeff
        (homogeneousTensorExponent (t + 1) b) = ∑ i : Fin 3,
      bW.repr (T i (bV k)) j *
        (X i * monomial (homogeneousTensorExponent t s) 1 : Poly K 3).coeff
          (homogeneousTensorExponent (t + 1) b)

name: ChoppedPlane.operatorLinearMatrix_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem operatorLinearMatrix_val (bV : Basis (Fin a) K V)
    (bW : Basis (Fin c) K W) (T : Fin 3 → V →ₗ[K] W) (k : Fin a) (j : Fin c) :
    (operatorLinearMatrix bV bW T k j).val =
      ∑ i : Fin 3, C (bW.repr (T i (bV k)) j) * X i

name: ChoppedPlane.operatorRaisedIndex_exponent
statement:
@[simp] theorem operatorRaisedIndex_exponent (t : ℕ) (s : Sym (Fin 3) t) (i : Fin 3) :
    homogeneousTensorExponent (t + 1) (operatorRaisedIndex t s i) =
      homogeneousTensorExponent t s + Finsupp.single i 1

name: ChoppedPlane.polynomialVectorCoefficient_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem polynomialVectorCoefficient_apply {n : ℕ} (k : Fin a)
    (s : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) (g : Fin a → Forms K 3 n) :
    polynomialVectorCoefficient k s g = (g k).val.coeff s

name: ChoppedPlane.finiteDirectionalSynthesis_coefficient
statement:
@[simp] theorem finiteDirectionalSynthesis_coefficient (ν : V →ₗ[K] M) (n : ℕ)
    (c : Sym (Fin 3) n → V) (s : Sym (Fin 3) n) :
    tensorCoefficients (finiteDirectionalSynthesis (R := R) ν n c)
      (homogeneousTensorExponent n s) = ν (c s)

name: ChoppedPlane.finiteDirectionalSynthesis_injective
statement:
theorem finiteDirectionalSynthesis_injective (ν : V →ₗ[K] M)
    (hν : Function.Injective ν) (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (finiteDirectionalSynthesis (R := R) ν n)

name: ChoppedPlane.finiteDirectionalSynthesis_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem finiteDirectionalSynthesis_zero (ν : V →ₗ[K] M) (n : ℕ) :
    finiteDirectionalSynthesis (R := R) ν n 0 = 0

name: ChoppedPlane.maximalMinorIdeal_map
statement:
theorem maximalMinorIdeal_map {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (φ : Poly K 3 →+* R) (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K 3)) :
    (maximalMinorIdeal B).map φ =
      Ideal.span (Set.range (signedMaximalMinor (B.map φ)))

name: ChoppedPlane.rowMatrix_form_cut_of_binary
statement:
theorem rowMatrix_form_cut_of_binary (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ)
    (B : HomogeneousRowMatrix K δ) (N : ℕ)
    (hcut : ∀ f : Forms K 2 N,
      f.val ∈ maximalMinorIdeal ((rowMatrixVal δ B).map Ferrers.infinityMap)) :
    ∀ f : Forms K 3 N, f.val ∈
      maximalMinorIdeal (rowMatrixVal δ B) ⊔ Ideal.span {X (R := K) 2}

name: ChoppedPlane.rowMatrix_quotient_finrank_eq
statement:
theorem rowMatrix_quotient_finrank_eq (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ)
    (B C : HomogeneousRowMatrix K δ)
    (hB : PrimitiveMaximalMinors (rowMatrixVal δ B))
    (hC : PrimitiveMaximalMinors (rowMatrixVal δ C)) (N : ℕ) :
    finrank K (Forms K 3 N ⧸ idealFormPiece (maximalMinorIdeal (rowMatrixVal δ B)) N) =
      finrank K (Forms K 3 N ⧸ idealFormPiece (maximalMinorIdeal (rowMatrixVal δ C)) N)

name: ChoppedPlane.rowMatrix_z_saturated
statement:
theorem rowMatrix_z_saturated (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ) (B : HomogeneousRowMatrix K δ)
    (hB : PrimitiveMaximalMinors ((rowMatrixVal δ B).map Ferrers.infinityMap)) :
    ∀ p : Poly K 3, X 2 * p ∈ maximalMinorIdeal (rowMatrixVal δ B) →
      p ∈ maximalMinorIdeal (rowMatrixVal δ B)

name: ChoppedPlane.universalDegreeCofactorMap_isPolynomialFamily
statement:
theorem universalDegreeCofactorMap_isPolynomialFamily (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ)
    (N : ℕ) :
    IsPolynomialFamily (fun u : RowMatrixParameter δ → K =>
      universalDegreeCofactorMap δ N u)

name: ChoppedPlane.universalDegreeCofactorMap_range
statement:
theorem universalDegreeCofactorMap_range (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ) (N : ℕ)
    (u : RowMatrixParameter δ → K) :
    (universalDegreeCofactorMap δ N u).range =
      idealFormPiece (maximalMinorIdeal (rowMatrixVal δ (universalRowMatrix δ u))) N

name: ChoppedPlane.universalDegreeCofactorMap_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem universalDegreeCofactorMap_val (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ) (N : ℕ)
    (u : RowMatrixParameter δ → K) (v : rowForms K 3 δ ((N : ℤ) - ∑ i, δ i)) :
    (universalDegreeCofactorMap δ N u v).val =
      (gradedCofactorMap (rowMatrixVal δ (universalRowMatrix δ u)) δ
        (rowMatrixVal_homogeneous δ _) ((N : ℤ) - ∑ i, δ i) v).val

name: ChoppedPlane.chopEqualsPointPiece_above
statement:
theorem chopEqualsPointPiece_above {q : ℕ} (a : PointCoordinates K p)
    (hq : d + 1 ≤ q) (hs : Function.Surjective (pointEvaluation K a d))
    (hbase : ChopEqualsPointPiece K a d q) :
    ∀ t, q ≤ t → ChopEqualsPointPiece K a d t

name: ChoppedPlane.chopEqualsPointPiece_iff_hilbert_eq
statement:
theorem chopEqualsPointPiece_iff_hilbert_eq (a : PointCoordinates K p) :
    ChopEqualsPointPiece K a d (d + e) ↔
      choppedHilbertFunction a d (d + e) = pointHilbertFunction K a (d + e)

name: ChoppedPlane.genericChoppedConclusion_intermediate_of_witness
statement:
theorem genericChoppedConclusion_intermediate_of_witness [CharZero K]
    (d p : ℕ) (hd : 2 ≤ d) (hlo : N (d - 1) < p) (hhi : p < N d)
    (hr : 3 ≤ N d - p) (a₀ : PointCoordinates K p)
    (hs : Function.Surjective (pointEvaluation K a₀ d))
    (hwitness : ∀ e, e ≤ cutoff d (N d - p) →
      choppedHilbertFunction a₀ d (d + e) = max p (N (d + e) - (N d - p) * N e)) :
    GenericChoppedConclusion K d p

name: ChoppedPlane.intermediate_formula_of_finite_witness
statement:
theorem intermediate_formula_of_finite_witness {p d : ℕ} (a : PointCoordinates K p)
    (hhi : p < N d) (hr : 3 ≤ N d - p)
    (hpoint : ∀ t, pointHilbertFunction K a t = min (N t) p)
    (hs : Function.Surjective (pointEvaluation K a d))
    (hfinite : ∀ e, e ≤ cutoff d (N d - p) →
      choppedHilbertFunction a d (d + e) = max p (N (d + e) - (N d - p) * N e)) :
    ∀ e, choppedHilbertFunction a d (d + e) = max p (N (d + e) - (N d - p) * N e)

name: ChoppedPlane.intermediate_max_eq_point_iff
ChoppedPlane.mainConclusion_of_intermediate_formula
statement:
theorem mainConclusion_of_intermediate_formula {p d : ℕ} (a : PointCoordinates K p)
    (hd : 2 ≤ d) (hlo : N (d - 1) < p) (hhi : p < N d) (hr : 3 ≤ N d - p)
    (hdist : DistinctPoints K a)
    (hpoint : ∀ t, pointHilbertFunction K a t = min (N t) p)
    (hchop : ∀ e, choppedHilbertFunction a d (d + e) =
      max p (N (d + e) - (N d - p) * N e)) : MainConclusion K a d

name: ChoppedPlane.pointDegreeSpace_eq_chop_of_piece_eq
statement:
theorem pointDegreeSpace_eq_chop_of_piece_eq {t : ℕ} (a : PointCoordinates K p)
    (h : ChopEqualsPointPiece K a d t) :
    pointDegreeSpace K a t = idealDegreeSpace (choppedIdeal K a d) t

name: ChoppedPlane.pointHilbertFunction_above_intermediate
statement:
theorem pointHilbertFunction_above_intermediate {p d e : ℕ} (a : PointCoordinates K p)
    (hp : p < N d) (hpoint : ∀ t, pointHilbertFunction K a t = min (N t) p) :
    pointHilbertFunction K a (d + e) = p

name: ChoppedPlane.choppedHilbertFunction_add_matrix_rank
statement:
theorem choppedHilbertFunction_add_matrix_rank (k : K →+* L) (a : PointCoordinates L p)
    (S : Matrix (Sym (Fin 3) d) (Fin p) (MvPolynomial (Fin p × Fin 2) K))
    (hdet : eval₂ k a (pointPolynomialMatrix K p d * S).det ≠ 0) (e : ℕ) :
    choppedHilbertFunction a d (d + e) +
      (polynomialMatrixEval k a (kernelProductPolynomialMatrix
        (matrixKernelChart (pointPolynomialMatrix K p d) S) e)).rank =
      (d + e + 2).choose 2

name: ChoppedPlane.choppedHilbertFunction_descend
statement:
theorem choppedHilbertFunction_descend [Infinite K]
    {J : Type*} [Fintype J] (k : K →+* L) (hp : p ≤ (d + 2).choose 2)
    (e : J → ℕ) (a₀ : J → PointCoordinates L p)
    (hsurj : ∀ j, Function.Surjective (pointEvaluation L (a₀ j) d)) :
    ∃ D : MvPolynomial (Fin p × Fin 2) K, (∃ a, eval a D ≠ 0) ∧
      ∀ a, eval a D ≠ 0 → Function.Surjective (pointEvaluation K a d) ∧
        ∀ j, choppedHilbertFunction a d (d + e j) ≤
          choppedHilbertFunction (a₀ j) d (d + e j)

name: ChoppedPlane.choppedHilbertFunction_extension_witnesses
statement:
theorem choppedHilbertFunction_extension_witnesses [Infinite K]
    {J : Type*} [Fintype J] (k : K →+* L)
    (S : Matrix (Sym (Fin 3) d) (Fin p) (MvPolynomial (Fin p × Fin 2) K))
    (hQ : (pointPolynomialMatrix K p d * S).det ≠ 0)
    (e : J → ℕ) (a₀ : J → PointCoordinates L p)
    (hdet : ∀ j, eval₂ k (a₀ j) (pointPolynomialMatrix K p d * S).det ≠ 0) :
    ∃ D : MvPolynomial (Fin p × Fin 2) K, (∃ a, eval a D ≠ 0) ∧
      ∀ a, eval a D ≠ 0 → Function.Surjective (pointEvaluation K a d) ∧
        ∀ j, choppedHilbertFunction a d (d + e j) ≤
          choppedHilbertFunction (a₀ j) d (d + e j)

name: ChoppedPlane.choppedHilbertFunction_extension_witnesses_of_surjective
statement:
theorem choppedHilbertFunction_extension_witnesses_of_surjective [Infinite K]
    {J : Type*} [Fintype J] (k : K →+* L)
    (S : Matrix (Sym (Fin 3) d) (Fin p) (MvPolynomial (Fin p × Fin 2) K))
    (hQ : (pointPolynomialMatrix K p d * S).det ≠ 0)
    (e : J → ℕ) (a₀ : J → PointCoordinates L p)
    (hsurj : ∀ j, Function.Surjective (pointEvaluation L (a₀ j) d)) :
    ∃ D : MvPolynomial (Fin p × Fin 2) K, (∃ a, eval a D ≠ 0) ∧
      ∀ a, eval a D ≠ 0 → Function.Surjective (pointEvaluation K a d) ∧
        ∀ j, choppedHilbertFunction a d (d + e j) ≤
          choppedHilbertFunction (a₀ j) d (d + e j)

name: ChoppedPlane.formProductCoordinates_map
statement:
theorem formProductCoordinates_map (k : K →+* L) :
    (formProductCoordinates K d e).map k = formProductCoordinates L d e

name: ChoppedPlane.formsMap_basis
statement:
@[simp] theorem formsMap_basis (k : K →+* L) (i : Sym (Fin n) d) :
    formsMap k (formsBasis K n d i) = formsBasis L n d i

name: ChoppedPlane.formsMap_coordinates
statement:
theorem formsMap_coordinates (k : K →+* L) (f : Forms K n d) (i : Sym (Fin n) d) :
    (formsBasis L n d).repr (formsMap k f) i = k ((formsBasis K n d).repr f i)

name: ChoppedPlane.formsMap_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem formsMap_val (k : K →+* L) (f : Forms K n d) :
    (formsMap k f).val = map k f.val

name: ChoppedPlane.kernelProductPolynomialMatrix_eval
statement:
theorem kernelProductPolynomialMatrix_eval {ι : Type*} (k : K →+* L) (a : ι → L)
    (C : Matrix (Sym (Fin 3) d) (Sym (Fin 3) d) (MvPolynomial ι K))
    (t : Sym (Fin 3) (d + e)) (ij : Sym (Fin 3) d × Sym (Fin 3) e) :
    polynomialMatrixEval k a (kernelProductPolynomialMatrix C e) t ij =
      (formsBasis L 3 (d + e)).repr
        (formProductBilinear (coordinateForm L d (polynomialMatrixEval k a C) ij.1)
          (formsBasis L 3 e ij.2)) t

name: ChoppedPlane.kernelProductPolynomialMatrix_rank
statement:
theorem kernelProductPolynomialMatrix_rank {ι : Type*} (k : K →+* L) (a : ι → L)
    (C : Matrix (Sym (Fin 3) d) (Sym (Fin 3) d) (MvPolynomial ι K)) :
    (polynomialMatrixEval k a (kernelProductPolynomialMatrix C e)).rank =
      finrank L (kernelProductSpace
        (formProductBilinear (K := L) (n := 3) (d := d) (e := e))
        (Submodule.span L (Set.range
          (coordinateForm L d (polynomialMatrixEval k a C)))))

name: ChoppedPlane.kernelProductSpace_span_basis
statement:
theorem kernelProductSpace_span_basis {J : Type*} [Fintype J]
    (q : J → Forms K 3 d) :
    Submodule.span K (Set.range (fun ij : J × Sym (Fin 3) e =>
      formProductBilinear (q ij.1) (formsBasis K 3 e ij.2))) =
      kernelProductSpace (formProductBilinear (K := K) (n := 3) (d := d) (e := e))
        (Submodule.span K (Set.range q))

name: ChoppedPlane.pointHilbertFunction_baseChange
statement:
theorem pointHilbertFunction_baseChange (k : K →+* L) (a : PointCoordinates K p) :
    pointHilbertFunction L (k ∘ a) d = pointHilbertFunction K a d

name: ChoppedPlane.pointPolynomialMatrix_coordinates
statement:
theorem pointPolynomialMatrix_coordinates (k : K →+* L) (a : PointCoordinates L p)
    (f : Forms L 3 d) :
    (polynomialMatrixEval k a (pointPolynomialMatrix K p d)).mulVecLin
      ((formsBasis L 3 d).equivFun f) = pointEvaluation L a d f

name: ChoppedPlane.pointPolynomialMatrix_eval
statement:
theorem pointPolynomialMatrix_eval (k : K →+* L) (a : PointCoordinates L p) :
    polynomialMatrixEval k a (pointPolynomialMatrix K p d) =
      LinearMap.toMatrix (formsBasis L 3 d) (Pi.basisFun L (Fin p))
        (pointEvaluation L a d)

name: ChoppedPlane.pointPolynomialMatrix_rank
statement:
theorem pointPolynomialMatrix_rank (k : K →+* L) (a : PointCoordinates L p) :
    (polynomialMatrixEval k a (pointPolynomialMatrix K p d)).rank =
      pointHilbertFunction L a d

name: ChoppedPlane.pointPolynomialMatrix_surjective_iff
statement:
theorem pointPolynomialMatrix_surjective_iff (k : K →+* L) (a : PointCoordinates L p) :
    Function.Surjective (polynomialMatrixEval k a (pointPolynomialMatrix K p d)).mulVecLin ↔
      Function.Surjective (pointEvaluation L a d)

name: ChoppedPlane.point_kernel_chart_columns_span
statement:
theorem point_kernel_chart_columns_span (k : K →+* L) (a : PointCoordinates L p)
    (S : Matrix (Sym (Fin 3) d) (Fin p) (MvPolynomial (Fin p × Fin 2) K))
    (hdet : eval₂ k a (pointPolynomialMatrix K p d * S).det ≠ 0) :
    Submodule.span L (Set.range (coordinateForm L d (polynomialMatrixEval k a
      (matrixKernelChart (pointPolynomialMatrix K p d) S)))) = pointDegreePiece L a d

name: ChoppedPlane.genericChoppedConclusion_of_extension_witnesses
statement:
theorem genericChoppedConclusion_of_extension_witnesses [CharZero K]
    (k : K →+* L) (d p : ℕ) (hd : 2 ≤ d)
    (hlo : N (d - 1) < p) (hhi : p < N d) (hr : 3 ≤ N d - p)
    (hw : ∀ e, e ≤ cutoff d (N d - p) →
      ∃ a : PointCoordinates L p,
        Function.Surjective (pointEvaluation L a d) ∧
        choppedHilbertFunction a d (d + e) ≤
          max p (N (d + e) - (N d - p) * N e)) :
    GenericChoppedConclusion K d p

name: ChoppedPlane.binary_coeff_boundary_zero
statement:
theorem binary_coeff_boundary_zero {a t : ℕ} (A : ℕ → ℕ → K)
    (hleft : ∀ i < a, A (i + 1) 0 = 0)
    (hright : ∀ i < a, A i t = 0)
    (hrec : ∀ i < a, ∀ j < t, A (i + 1) (j + 1) + A i j = 0)
    (hta : t < a) (i : ℕ) (hia : i ≤ a) (j : ℕ) (hjt : j ≤ t) :
    A i j = 0

name: ChoppedPlane.binary_coeff_lower_left
statement:
theorem binary_coeff_lower_left {a t : ℕ} (A : ℕ → ℕ → K)
    (hleft : ∀ i < a, A (i + 1) 0 = 0)
    (hrec : ∀ i < a, ∀ j < t, A (i + 1) (j + 1) + A i j = 0)
    (j : ℕ) (hjt : j ≤ t) (i : ℕ) (hia : i ≤ a) (hji : j < i) :
    A i j = 0

name: ChoppedPlane.binary_coeff_upper_right
statement:
theorem binary_coeff_upper_right {a t : ℕ} (A : ℕ → ℕ → K)
    (hright : ∀ i < a, A i t = 0)
    (hrec : ∀ i < a, ∀ j < t, A (i + 1) (j + 1) + A i j = 0)
    (k : ℕ) (hkt : k ≤ t) (i : ℕ) (hik : i + k < a) :
    A i (t - k) = 0

name: ChoppedPlane.homogeneous_div_x
statement:
theorem homogeneous_div_x {t : ℕ} (p : Poly K 3)
    (hp : p.IsHomogeneous (t + 1)) :
    (p.divMonomial (Finsupp.single 0 1)).IsHomogeneous t

name: ChoppedPlane.x_mul_div_of_x_dvd
statement:
theorem x_mul_div_of_x_dvd (p : Poly K 3) (hdiv : X 0 ∣ p) :
    X 0 * p.divMonomial (Finsupp.single 0 1) = p

name: ChoppedPlane.coeff_x_at_x_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem coeff_x_at_x_zero (p : Poly K 3) (j k : ℕ) :
    (X 0 * p).coeff (planeExponent 0 j k) = 0

name: ChoppedPlane.coeff_y_at_y_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem coeff_y_at_y_succ (p : Poly K 3) (h j k : ℕ) :
    (X 1 * p).coeff (planeExponent h (j+1) k) = p.coeff (planeExponent h j k)

name: ChoppedPlane.coeff_y_at_y_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem coeff_y_at_y_zero (p : Poly K 3) (h k : ℕ) :
    (X 1 * p).coeff (planeExponent h 0 k) = 0

name: ChoppedPlane.coeff_z_at_z_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem coeff_z_at_z_succ (p : Poly K 3) (h j k : ℕ) :
    (X 2 * p).coeff (planeExponent h j (k+1)) = p.coeff (planeExponent h j k)

name: ChoppedPlane.toeplitzMatrix_map_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem toeplitzMatrix_map_val {a t : ℕ}
    (v : MatrixSource K (a+2) t) (i : Fin a) :
    (linearMatrixMap (toeplitzMatrix K a) t v i).val =
      X 0 * (v ⟨i.val, by omega⟩).val +
      X 1 * (v ⟨i.val+1, by omega⟩).val +
      X 2 * (v ⟨i.val+2, by omega⟩).val

name: ChoppedPlane.toeplitzMatrix_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem toeplitzMatrix_val {a : ℕ} (i : Fin a) (j : Fin (a+2)) :
    (toeplitzMatrix K a i j).val =
      (if j = (⟨i.val, by omega⟩ : Fin (a+2)) then X 0 else 0) +
      (if j = (⟨i.val+1, by omega⟩ : Fin (a+2)) then X 1 else 0) +
      (if j = (⟨i.val+2, by omega⟩ : Fin (a+2)) then X 2 else 0)

name: ChoppedPlane.combined_quotient_coordinates
statement:
theorem combined_quotient_coordinates
    {A : Type*} [AddCommGroup A] [Module K A]
    (q : V →ₗ[K] A) (r : α → V) (l : κ → V) (b : Basis κ K A)
    (hr : ∀ i, q (r i) = 0) (hl : ∀ i, q (l i) = b i)
    (c : Sum α κ → K) (k : κ) :
    b.repr (q (finiteCombination (K := K) (Sum.elim r l) c)) k = c (.inr k)

name: ChoppedPlane.polynomial_combination_adjugate_chart
statement:
theorem polynomial_combination_adjugate_chart
    (r : α → (ι → K) → V) (l : κ → (ι → K) → V)
    (hr : ∀ i, IsPolynomialFamily (r i))
    (hl : ∀ i, IsPolynomialFamily (l i))
    (a₀ : ι → K)
    (h₀ : Function.Bijective
      (finiteCombination (K := K) (Sum.elim (fun i => r i a₀) (fun i => l i a₀)))) :
    ∃ (D : MvPolynomial ι K)
      (R : (ι → K) → (V →ₗ[K] (Sum α κ → K))),
      eval a₀ D = 1 ∧ IsPolynomialFamily R ∧
      ∀ a,
        (finiteCombination (K := K) (Sum.elim (fun i => r i a) (fun i => l i a))).comp
          (R a) = (eval a D) • LinearMap.id

name: ChoppedPlane.polynomial_quotient_multiplication_chart
statement:
theorem polynomial_quotient_multiplication_chart
    (H₀ : MvPolynomial ι K)
    (b : ∀ a, eval a H₀ ≠ 0 → Basis κ K (A a))
    (q : ∀ a, V →ₗ[K] A a)
    (r : α → (ι → K) → V) (l : κ → (ι → K) → V)
    (p : κ → κ → (ι → K) → V)
    (hrpoly : ∀ i, IsPolynomialFamily (r i))
    (hlpoly : ∀ i, IsPolynomialFamily (l i))
    (hppoly : ∀ i j, IsPolynomialFamily (p i j))
    (hr : ∀ a, eval a H₀ ≠ 0 → ∀ i, q a (r i a) = 0)
    (hl : ∀ a (ha : eval a H₀ ≠ 0) i, q a (l i a) = b a ha i)
    (hp : ∀ a (ha : eval a H₀ ≠ 0) i j,
      q a (p i j a) = b a ha i * b a ha j)
    (a₀ : ι → K) (hH₀ : eval a₀ H₀ ≠ 0)
    (h₀ : Function.Bijective
      (finiteCombination (K := K) (Sum.elim (fun i => r i a₀) (fun i => l i a₀)))) :
    ∃ (H : MvPolynomial ι K)
      (M : κ → Matrix κ κ (MvPolynomial ι K)),
      eval a₀ H ≠ 0 ∧
      (∀ a, eval a H ≠ 0 → eval a H₀ ≠ 0) ∧
      ∀ a (ha : eval a H₀ ≠ 0),
        ∀ i, (M i).map (eval a) = (eval a H) •
          Algebra.leftMulMatrix (b a ha) (b a ha i)

name: ChoppedPlane.polynomial_relations_for_quotient_basis
statement:
theorem polynomial_relations_for_quotient_basis
    {U W : Type*} [AddCommGroup U] [Module K U] [FiniteDimensional K U]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W] [FiniteDimensional K W]
    (E : (ι → K) → (U →ₗ[K] V)) (hE : IsPolynomialFamily E)
    (a₀ : ι → K) (q : V →ₗ[K] W)
    (hker : LinearMap.range (E a₀) = LinearMap.ker q)
    (b : Basis κ K W) (l : κ → V) (hl : ∀ i, q (l i) = b i) :
    ∃ r : Fin (finrank K (LinearMap.range (E a₀))) → (ι → K) → V,
      (∀ i, IsPolynomialFamily (r i)) ∧
      (∀ a i, r i a ∈ LinearMap.range (E a)) ∧
      Function.Bijective
        (finiteCombination (K := K) (Sum.elim (fun i => r i a₀) l))

name: ChoppedPlane.reduced_principal_open_of_polynomial_quotient_chart
statement:
theorem reduced_principal_open_of_polynomial_quotient_chart
    (H₀ : MvPolynomial ι K)
    (b : ∀ a, eval a H₀ ≠ 0 → Basis κ K (A a))
    (q : ∀ a, V →ₗ[K] A a)
    (r : α → (ι → K) → V) (l : κ → (ι → K) → V)
    (p : κ → κ → (ι → K) → V)
    (hrpoly : ∀ i, IsPolynomialFamily (r i))
    (hlpoly : ∀ i, IsPolynomialFamily (l i))
    (hppoly : ∀ i j, IsPolynomialFamily (p i j))
    (hr : ∀ a, eval a H₀ ≠ 0 → ∀ i, q a (r i a) = 0)
    (hl : ∀ a (ha : eval a H₀ ≠ 0) i, q a (l i a) = b a ha i)
    (hp : ∀ a (ha : eval a H₀ ≠ 0) i j,
      q a (p i j a) = b a ha i * b a ha j)
    (a₀ : ι → K) (hH₀ : eval a₀ H₀ ≠ 0)
    (h₀ : Function.Bijective
      (finiteCombination (K := K) (Sum.elim (fun i => r i a₀) (fun i => l i a₀))))
    (e : A a₀ ≃ₐ[K] (κ → K)) :
    ∃ D : MvPolynomial ι K, eval a₀ D ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ a, eval a D ≠ 0 → IsReduced (A a)

name: ChoppedPlane.universalRowMatrix_reduced_principal_open
statement:
theorem universalRowMatrix_reduced_principal_open
    (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ) (N : ℕ)
    (H₀ : MvPolynomial (RowMatrixParameter δ) K)
    (a₀ : RowMatrixParameter δ → K) (hH₀ : eval a₀ H₀ ≠ 0)
    (hprimitive : ∀ a, eval a H₀ ≠ 0 →
      PrimitiveMaximalMinors (rowMatrixVal δ (universalRowMatrix δ a)))
    (hbinary : ∀ a, eval a H₀ ≠ 0 →
      PrimitiveMaximalMinors (universalInfinityMatrix δ a))
    (hcut : ∀ a, eval a H₀ ≠ 0 → ∀ f : Forms K 2 N,
      f.val ∈ maximalMinorIdeal (universalInfinityMatrix δ a))
    (splitWitness :
      AffineCoordinateAlgebra (maximalMinorIdeal
        (rowMatrixVal δ (universalRowMatrix δ a₀))) ≃ₐ[K] (κ → K)) :
    ∃ D : MvPolynomial (RowMatrixParameter δ) K,
      eval a₀ D ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ a, eval a D ≠ 0 →
        eval a H₀ ≠ 0 ∧
        IsReduced (AffineCoordinateAlgebra (maximalMinorIdeal
          (rowMatrixVal δ (universalRowMatrix δ a)))) ∧
        Module.Finite K (AffineCoordinateAlgebra (maximalMinorIdeal
          (rowMatrixVal δ (universalRowMatrix δ a)))) ∧
        finrank K (AffineCoordinateAlgebra (maximalMinorIdeal
          (rowMatrixVal δ (universalRowMatrix δ a)))) = Fintype.card κ

name: ChoppedPlane.pair_generatedHilbertFunction
statement:
theorem pair_generatedHilbertFunction (q : Fin 2 → Forms K 3 d)
    (hq : (q 0).val ≠ 0) (hcop : IsRelPrime (q 0).val (q 1).val) (t : ℕ) :
    (generatedHilbertFunction (generatorSpace q) t : ℤ) =
      N₂ (t : ℤ) - 2 * N₂ ((t : ℤ) - d) + N₂ ((t : ℤ) - 2 * d)

name: ChoppedPlane.pair_hilbert_above_double
statement:
theorem pair_hilbert_above_double (q : Fin 2 → Forms K n d) (hed : d ≤ e)

    generatedHilbertFunction (generatorSpace q) (d + e) +
      2 * finrank K (Forms K n e) =
      finrank K (Forms K n (d + e)) + finrank K (Forms K n (e - d))

name: ChoppedPlane.pair_hilbert_below_double

name: ChoppedPlane.pair_regular_principal_open
statement:
theorem pair_regular_principal_open {ι : Type*} (hd : 0 < d)
    (q : (ι → K) → (Fin 2 → Forms K 3 d)) (hpoly : IsPolynomialFamily q)
    (a₀ : ι → K) (hq₀ : (q a₀ 0).val ≠ 0)
    (hcop₀ : IsRelPrime (q a₀ 0).val (q a₀ 1).val) :
    ∃ D : MvPolynomial ι K, eval a₀ D ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ a, eval a D ≠ 0 →
      IsRelPrime (q a 0).val (q a 1).val ∧
      RingTheory.Sequence.IsRegular (Poly K 3) [(q a 0).val, (q a 1).val] ∧
      ∀ t, (generatedHilbertFunction (generatorSpace (q a)) t : ℤ) =
        N₂ (t : ℤ) - 2 * N₂ ((t : ℤ) - d) + N₂ ((t : ℤ) - 2 * d)

name: ChoppedPlane.rowMatrixVal_ferrers
statement:
@[simp] theorem rowMatrixVal_ferrers (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ)

    rowMatrixVal δ (ferrersHomogeneousRowMatrix δ α β) = Ferrers.seedMatrix δ α β

name: ChoppedPlane.universalRowMatrix_primitive_cut_principal_open
statement:
theorem universalRowMatrix_primitive_cut_principal_open
    (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ) (hdegree : 0 < ∑ i, δ i)
    (α β : Ferrers.RootIndex δ → K) :
    ∃ D : MvPolynomial (RowMatrixParameter δ) K,
      eval (rowMatrixCoordinates δ (ferrersHomogeneousRowMatrix δ α β)) D ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ u, eval u D ≠ 0 →
        PrimitiveMaximalMinors (rowMatrixVal δ (universalRowMatrix δ u)) ∧
        PrimitiveMaximalMinors (universalInfinityMatrix δ u) ∧
        ∀ f : Forms K 2 (2 * ∑ i, δ i),
          f.val ∈ maximalMinorIdeal (universalInfinityMatrix δ u)

name: ChoppedPlane.universalRowMatrix_primitive_principal_open
statement:
theorem universalRowMatrix_primitive_principal_open
    (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ) (hdegree : 0 < ∑ i, δ i)
    (α β : Ferrers.RootIndex δ → K) :
    ∃ D : MvPolynomial (RowMatrixParameter δ) K,
      eval (rowMatrixCoordinates δ (ferrersHomogeneousRowMatrix δ α β)) D ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ u, eval u D ≠ 0 →
        PrimitiveMaximalMinors (rowMatrixVal δ (universalRowMatrix δ u))

name: ChoppedPlane.universalRowMatrix_actual_points_principal_open
statement:
theorem universalRowMatrix_actual_points_principal_open [Infinite K] [IsAlgClosed K]
    (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ) (hdegree : 0 < ∑ i, δ i) :
    ∃ D : MvPolynomial (RowMatrixParameter δ) K,
      (∃ u, eval u D ≠ 0) ∧ ∀ u, eval u D ≠ 0 →
        PrimitiveMaximalMinors (rowMatrixVal δ (universalRowMatrix δ u)) ∧
        ∃ a : PointCoordinates K (Fintype.card (Ferrers.SelectedIndex δ)),
          DistinctPoints K a ∧
          ∀ t, pointDegreePiece K a t = idealFormPiece
            (maximalMinorIdeal (rowMatrixVal δ (universalRowMatrix δ u))) t

name: ChoppedPlane.universalRowMatrix_points_principal_open
statement:
theorem universalRowMatrix_points_principal_open [Infinite K]
    (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ) (hdegree : 0 < ∑ i, δ i) :
    ∃ D : MvPolynomial (RowMatrixParameter δ) K,
      (∃ u, eval u D ≠ 0) ∧ ∀ u, eval u D ≠ 0 →
        PrimitiveMaximalMinors (rowMatrixVal δ (universalRowMatrix δ u)) ∧
        PrimitiveMaximalMinors (universalInfinityMatrix δ u) ∧
        (∀ f : Forms K 2 (2 * ∑ i, δ i),
          f.val ∈ maximalMinorIdeal (universalInfinityMatrix δ u)) ∧
        IsReduced (AffineCoordinateAlgebra (maximalMinorIdeal
          (rowMatrixVal δ (universalRowMatrix δ u)))) ∧
        Module.Finite K (AffineCoordinateAlgebra (maximalMinorIdeal
          (rowMatrixVal δ (universalRowMatrix δ u)))) ∧
        finrank K (AffineCoordinateAlgebra (maximalMinorIdeal
          (rowMatrixVal δ (universalRowMatrix δ u)))) =
            Fintype.card (Ferrers.SelectedIndex δ)

    (hγ : ∀ i, γ i ∈ polynomialLaurentGrade (δ i))
    (hdegree : ∀ i, δ i + h i = d + g (σ i)) (k : ℤ) :

      (laurentOperator γ σ).comp (gradeProjection g k)

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.laurentOperator_supported
statement:
theorem laurentOperator_supported (γ : ι → BinaryLaurent K) (σ : ι → ι)
    (g h : ι → ℤ) (d : ℤ) (δ : ι → ℤ)
    (hγ : ∀ i, γ i ∈ polynomialLaurentGrade (δ i))
    (hdegree : ∀ i, δ i + h i = d + g (σ i))
    (P : ℤ × ℤ → Prop)
    (hP : ∀ a b : ℤ × ℤ, 0 ≤ a.1 → 0 ≤ a.2 → P b → P (a + b))
    (k : ℤ) (p : FreeLaurent K ι)
    (hp : p ∈ Finsupp.supported K K
      {e : ι × (ℤ × ℤ) | e.2.1 + e.2.2 + g e.1 = k ∧ P e.2}) :
    laurentOperator γ σ p ∈ Finsupp.supported K K
      {e : ι × (ℤ × ℤ) | e.2.1 + e.2.2 + h e.1 = k + d ∧ P e.2}

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.laurentProfileZDual_mem_overlapGrade
statement:
theorem laurentProfileZDual_mem_overlapGrade (q : K) (s : CubicProfile)

name: ChoppedPlane.GradedLocalExactness.gradedRestriction_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem gradedRestriction_val (L : U →ₗ[K] V)
    (G : Submodule K U) (H : Submodule K V)
    (hL : ∀ u, u ∈ G → L u ∈ H) (u : G) :
    (gradedRestriction L G H hL u).val = L u.val

name: ChoppedPlane.GradedLocalExactness.graded_kernel_range
statement:
theorem graded_kernel_range
    (G : ℤ → Submodule K U) (H : ℤ → Submodule K V)
    (pU : ℤ → U →ₗ[K] U) (pV : ℤ → V →ₗ[K] V)
    (hpU : ∀ k u, pU k u ∈ G k)
    (hpV : ∀ k v, v ∈ H k → pV k v = v)
    (L : U →ₗ[K] V) (Q : V →ₗ[K] W)
    (hexact : ∀ v, Q v = 0 ↔ v ∈ LinearMap.range L)
    (a b : ℤ) (hcomm : L.comp (pU a) = (pV b).comp L)
    (hL : ∀ u, u ∈ G a → L u ∈ H b) :
    LinearMap.ker (Q.domRestrict (H b)) =
      LinearMap.range (gradedRestriction L (G a) (H b) hL)

name: ChoppedPlane.GradedLocalExactness.graded_preimage
statement:
theorem graded_preimage
    (G : ℤ → Submodule K U) (H : ℤ → Submodule K V)
    (pU : ℤ → U →ₗ[K] U) (pV : ℤ → V →ₗ[K] V)
    (hpU : ∀ k u, pU k u ∈ G k)
    (hpV : ∀ k v, v ∈ H k → pV k v = v)
    (L : U →ₗ[K] V) (Q : V →ₗ[K] W)
    (hexact : ∀ v, Q v = 0 ↔ v ∈ LinearMap.range L)
    (a b : ℤ) (hcomm : L.comp (pU a) = (pV b).comp L)
    (v : V) (hv : v ∈ H b) (hq : Q v = 0) :
    ∃ u : U, u ∈ G a ∧ L u = v

name: ChoppedPlane.GradedLocalExactness.graded_preimage_of_kernel_range
statement:
theorem graded_preimage_of_kernel_range
    (G : ℤ → Submodule K U) (H : ℤ → Submodule K V)
    (pU : ℤ → U →ₗ[K] U) (pV : ℤ → V →ₗ[K] V)
    (hpU : ∀ k u, pU k u ∈ G k)
    (hpV : ∀ k v, v ∈ H k → pV k v = v)
    (L : U →ₗ[K] V) (Q : V →ₗ[K] W)
    (hexact : LinearMap.ker Q = LinearMap.range L)
    (a b : ℤ) (hcomm : L.comp (pU a) = (pV b).comp L)
    (v : V) (hv : v ∈ H b) (hq : Q v = 0) :
    ∃ u : U, u ∈ G a ∧ L u = v

name: ChoppedPlane.GradedLocalExactness.graded_preimage_of_shift
statement:
theorem graded_preimage_of_shift
    (G : ℤ → Submodule K U) (H : ℤ → Submodule K V)
    (pU : ℤ → U →ₗ[K] U) (pV : ℤ → V →ₗ[K] V)
    (hpU : ∀ k u, pU k u ∈ G k)
    (hpV : ∀ k v, v ∈ H k → pV k v = v)
    (L : U →ₗ[K] V) (Q : V →ₗ[K] W)
    (hexact : ∀ v, Q v = 0 ↔ v ∈ LinearMap.range L)
    (d : ℤ) (hcomm : ∀ k, L.comp (pU k) = (pV (k + d)).comp L)
    (k : ℤ) (v : V) (hv : v ∈ H k) (hq : Q v = 0) :
    ∃ u : U, u ∈ G (k - d) ∧ L u = v

name: ChoppedPlane.GradedLocalExactness.uChart_graded_local_preimage
statement:
theorem uChart_graded_local_preimage
    (g : ι → ℤ) (h : κ → ℤ)
    (L : FreeLaurent K ι →ₗ[K] FreeLaurent K κ)
    (Q : FreeLaurent K κ →ₗ[K] W)
    (hL : ∀ j x, x ∈ overlapGrade (K := K) g j →
      L x ∈ overlapGrade (K := K) h (j + 1))
    (hexact : ∀ p : FreeLaurent K κ,
      p ∈ LinearMap.range (uFreeEmbedding (K := K) (ι := κ)) → Q p = 0 →
      ∃ x : FreeLaurent K ι,
        x ∈ LinearMap.range (uFreeEmbedding (K := K) (ι := ι)) ∧ L x = p)
    (k : ℤ) (p : FreeLaurent K κ) (hp : p ∈ uChartGrade (K := K) h k)
    (hq : Q p = 0) :
    ∃ x : FreeLaurent K ι, x ∈ uChartGrade (K := K) g (k - 1) ∧ L x = p

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.degree_piece_eq_grid_span
statement:
theorem degree_piece_eq_grid_span {p d : ℕ} (α β : Fin d → K)
    (coords : PointCoordinates K p)
    (hkernel : ∀ f : Forms K 3 d,
      (∀ i, eval (chartPoint K coords i) f.val = 0) ↔
        ∃ a b : K, f = a • firstForm α + b • secondForm β) :
    pointDegreePiece K coords d =
      span K ({firstForm α,secondForm β} : Set (Forms K 3 d))

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.exists_grid_subset
statement:
theorem exists_grid_subset {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (α β : Fin d → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β) :
    ∃ coords : PointCoordinates K ((d + 2).choose 2 - 2),
      DistinctPoints K coords ∧
      (∀ f : Forms K 3 d,
        (∀ i, MvPolynomial.eval (chartPoint K coords i) f.val = 0) ↔
          ∃ a b : K, f = a • firstForm α + b • secondForm β) ∧
      RingTheory.Sequence.IsRegular (Poly K 3) [planeFirst α,planeSecond β]

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.exists_spanning_grid_coordinates
statement:
theorem exists_spanning_grid_coordinates {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (α β : Fin d → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β) :
    ∃ sel : Fin ((d + 2).choose 2 - 2) → Fin d × Fin d,
      Function.Injective sel ∧
      span K (Set.range (gridEvaluation α β ∘ sel)) =
        span K (Set.range (gridEvaluation α β))

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.exists_two_generator_rank_witness
statement:
theorem exists_two_generator_rank_witness (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) :
    ∃ (coords : PointCoordinates K ((d + 2).choose 2 - 2)) (f g : Forms K 3 d),
      DistinctPoints K coords ∧
      pointDegreePiece K coords d = span K ({f,g} : Set (Forms K 3 d)) ∧
      finrank K (pointDegreePiece K coords d) = 2 ∧
      Function.Surjective (pointEvaluation K coords d) ∧
      (∀ t : ℕ, t < d → Function.Injective (pointEvaluation K coords t)) ∧
      f.val ≠ 0 ∧ IsRelPrime f.val g.val ∧
      RingTheory.Sequence.IsRegular (Poly K 3) [f.val,g.val]

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.exists_two_generator_witness
statement:
theorem exists_two_generator_witness (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) :
    ∃ (coords : PointCoordinates K ((d + 2).choose 2 - 2))
      (f g : Forms K 3 d),
      DistinctPoints K coords ∧
      (∀ h : Forms K 3 d,
        (∀ i, eval (chartPoint K coords i) h.val = 0) ↔
          ∃ a b : K, h = a • f + b • g) ∧
      RingTheory.Sequence.IsRegular (Poly K 3) [f.val,g.val] ∧
      (∀ t : ℕ, t < d → ∀ h : Forms K 3 t,
        (∀ i, eval (chartPoint K coords i) h.val = 0) → h = 0)

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.auxiliaryResiduePair_basis
statement:
@[simp] theorem auxiliaryResiduePair_basis [Finite J] [CharZero K]
    (g : J → ℤ) (r : ℤ) (n : ℕ)
    (q : negativeGrade (K := K) (auxiliaryGeneratorWeights g n) r)
    (e : PositiveIndex (auxiliaryGeneratorWeights g n) r) :
    auxiliaryResiduePair g r n q (positiveBasis (auxiliaryGeneratorWeights g n) r e) =
      ChoppedPlane.factorialWeight K (SymmetricDerivative.homogeneousTensorExponent n e.val.1.2) *
        q.val (complementIndex (auxiliaryGeneratorWeights g n) r e).val

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.freeLaurentEquiv_shift_mul
statement:
theorem freeLaurentEquiv_shift_mul [Finite ι] (m : ℤ × ℤ)

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.weightedNegativeCoordinates_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem weightedNegativeCoordinates_apply [Finite ι] (g : ι → ℤ) (r : ℤ)
    (w : ι → K) (hw : ∀ i, w i ≠ 0) (q : negativeGrade (K := K) g r)
    (e : PositiveIndex g r) :
    weightedNegativeCoordinates g r w hw q e = w e.val.1 * q.val (complementIndex g r e).val

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.weightedResiduePair_basis
statement:
@[simp] theorem weightedResiduePair_basis [Finite ι] (g : ι → ℤ) (r : ℤ)
    (w : ι → K) (hw : ∀ i, w i ≠ 0) (q : negativeGrade (K := K) g r)
    (e : PositiveIndex g r) :
    weightedResiduePair g r w hw q (positiveBasis g r e) =
      w e.val.1 * q.val (complementIndex g r e).val

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.weightedResiduePair_shift
statement:
theorem weightedResiduePair_shift [Finite ι] (g : ι → ℤ) (r : ℤ) (m : ℕ × ℕ)
    (w : ι → K) (hw : ∀ i, w i ≠ 0)
    (q : negativeGrade (K := K) g (r+m.1+m.2)) (p : positiveGrade (K := K) g r) :
    weightedResiduePair g (r+m.1+m.2) w hw q (positiveShift g r m p) =
      weightedResiduePair g r w hw (negativeShift g r m q) p

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.freeLaurentEquiv_positiveBasis
statement:
theorem freeLaurentEquiv_positiveBasis [Finite ι] (g : ι → ℤ) (r : ℤ)
    (e : PositiveIndex g r) (i : ι) :
    freeLaurentEquiv (positiveBasis (K := K) g r e).val i =
      if e.val.1 = i then AddMonoidAlgebra.single e.val.2 1 else 0

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.residueCoefficient_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem residueCoefficient_apply (p : BinaryLaurent K) :
    residueCoefficient p = p.coeff (-1,-1)

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.vectorResidueFunctional_apply
statement:
theorem vectorResidueFunctional_apply [Fintype ι] (w : ι → K)
    (q p : ι → BinaryLaurent K) :
    vectorResidueFunctional w q p =
      ∑ i : ι, w i * (q i * p i).coeff (-1,-1)

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.vectorResidueFunctional_basis
statement:
theorem vectorResidueFunctional_basis [Finite ι] (g : ι → ℤ) (r : ℤ)
    (w : ι → K) (q : negativeGrade (K := K) g r) (e : PositiveIndex g r) :
    vectorResidueFunctional w (freeLaurentEquiv q.val)
      (freeLaurentEquiv (positiveBasis g r e).val) =
      w e.val.1 * q.val (complementIndex g r e).val

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.vectorResidueFunctional_cyclic_transpose
statement:
theorem vectorResidueFunctional_cyclic_transpose (c : K)
    (γ m q : Fin 3 → BinaryLaurent K) :
    vectorResidueFunctional (fun _ : Fin 3 => c) q (QWeyl.cyclicZ γ m) =
      vectorResidueFunctional (fun _ : Fin 3 => c) (QWeyl.cyclicZDual γ q) m

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.weightedResiduePair_eq_vectorResidue
statement:
theorem weightedResiduePair_eq_vectorResidue [Finite ι] (g : ι → ℤ) (r : ℤ)
    (w : ι → K) (hw : ∀ i, w i ≠ 0)
    (q : negativeGrade (K := K) g r) (p : positiveGrade (K := K) g r) :
    weightedResiduePair g r w hw q p =
      vectorResidueFunctional w (freeLaurentEquiv q.val) (freeLaurentEquiv p.val)

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.auxiliaryCoefficientPair_adjoint
statement:
theorem auxiliaryCoefficientPair_adjoint
    (α : V' →ₗ[K] V →ₗ[K] K) (β : W' →ₗ[K] W →ₗ[K] K)
    (T : Fin 3 → V →ₗ[K] W) (L : Fin 3 → W' →ₗ[K] V')
    (h : ∀ i q p, β q (T i p) = α (L i q) p) (t : ℕ)
    (q : Sym (Fin 3) t → W') (p : Sym (Fin 3) (t + 1) → V) :
    auxiliaryCoefficientPair β t q (operatorDifferential T t p) =
      auxiliaryCoefficientPair α (t + 1) (auxiliaryOperatorMultiply L t q) p

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.auxiliaryOperatorMultiply_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem auxiliaryOperatorMultiply_apply (L : Fin 3 → W' →ₗ[K] V') (t : ℕ)
    (q : Sym (Fin 3) t → W') (b : Sym (Fin 3) (t + 1)) :
    auxiliaryOperatorMultiply L t q b = ∑ s : Sym (Fin 3) t, ∑ i : Fin 3,
      (X i * monomial (homogeneousTensorExponent t s) 1 : Poly K 3).coeff
        (homogeneousTensorExponent (t + 1) b) • L i (q s)

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.auxiliaryResiduePair_eq_coefficientPair
statement:
theorem auxiliaryResiduePair_eq_coefficientPair [Finite J] [CharZero K]
    (g : J → ℤ) (r : ℤ) (t : ℕ)
    (q : negativeGrade (K := K) (auxiliaryGeneratorWeights g t) r)
    (p : positiveGrade (K := K) (auxiliaryGeneratorWeights g t) r) :
    auxiliaryResiduePair g r t q p =
      auxiliaryCoefficientPair (residuePair g r) t
        (negativeGradeSplit g r q) (positiveGradeSplit g r p)

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.freeLaurentEquiv_split
statement:
@[simp] theorem freeLaurentEquiv_split [Finite J] [Finite S]
    (p : FreeLaurent K (J × S)) (j : J) (s : S) :
    freeLaurentEquiv p (j,s) = freeLaurentEquiv (splitFreeLaurentEquiv p s) j

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.negativeGradeSplit_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem negativeGradeSplit_apply [Finite S] (g : J → ℤ) (r : ℤ)
    (p : negativeGrade (K := K) (fun i : J × S => g i.1) r)
    (s : S) (e : J × (ℤ × ℤ)) :
    (negativeGradeSplit g r p s).val e = p.val ((e.1,s),e.2)

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.positiveGradeSplit_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem positiveGradeSplit_apply [Finite S] (g : J → ℤ) (r : ℤ)
    (p : positiveGrade (K := K) (fun i : J × S => g i.1) r)
    (s : S) (e : J × (ℤ × ℤ)) :
    (positiveGradeSplit g r p s).val e = p.val ((e.1,s),e.2)

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.residuePair_eq_vectorResidue
statement:
theorem residuePair_eq_vectorResidue [Finite J] (g : J → ℤ) (r : ℤ)
    (q : negativeGrade (K := K) g r) (p : positiveGrade (K := K) g r) :
    residuePair g r q p = vectorResidueFunctional (fun _ => 1)
      (freeLaurentEquiv q.val) (freeLaurentEquiv p.val)

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.splitFreeLaurentEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem splitFreeLaurentEquiv_apply [Finite S]
    (p : FreeLaurent K (J × S)) (s : S) (e : J × (ℤ × ℤ)) :
    splitFreeLaurentEquiv p s e = p ((e.1,s),e.2)

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.splitFreeLaurentEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem splitFreeLaurentEquiv_symm_apply [Finite S]
    (p : S → FreeLaurent K J) (e : (J × S) × (ℤ × ℤ)) :
    splitFreeLaurentEquiv.symm p e = p e.1.2 (e.1.1,e.2)

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.weightedResiduePair_one
statement:
theorem weightedResiduePair_one [Finite J] (g : J → ℤ) (r : ℤ)
    (q : negativeGrade (K := K) g r) (p : positiveGrade (K := K) g r) :
    weightedResiduePair g r (fun _ => 1) (fun _ => one_ne_zero) q p =
      residuePair g r q p

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.auxiliaryCoefficientResidueDualEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem auxiliaryCoefficientResidueDualEquiv_apply [Finite J] [CharZero K]
    (g : J → ℤ) (r : ℤ) (t : ℕ)
    (q : Sym (Fin 3) t → negativeGrade (K := K) g r)
    (p : Sym (Fin 3) t → positiveGrade (K := K) g r) :
    auxiliaryCoefficientResidueDualEquiv g r t q p =
      auxiliaryCoefficientPair (residuePair g r) t q p

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.auxiliaryCoefficientResidueDualEquiv_adjoint
statement:
theorem auxiliaryCoefficientResidueDualEquiv_adjoint [Finite J] [CharZero K]
    (g : J → ℤ) (r : ℤ)
    (T : Fin 3 → positiveGrade (K := K) g r →ₗ[K] positiveGrade (K := K) g (r + 1))
    (L : Fin 3 → negativeGrade (K := K) g (r + 1) →ₗ[K] negativeGrade (K := K) g r)
    (h : ∀ i q p, residuePair g (r + 1) q (T i p) = residuePair g r (L i q) p)
    (t : ℕ) (q : Sym (Fin 3) t → negativeGrade (K := K) g (r + 1))
    (p : Sym (Fin 3) (t + 1) → positiveGrade (K := K) g r) :
    auxiliaryCoefficientResidueDualEquiv g r (t + 1)
        (auxiliaryOperatorMultiply (K := K) L t q) p =
      auxiliaryCoefficientResidueDualEquiv g (r + 1) t q
        (operatorDifferential (K := K) T t p)

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.operatorDifferential_surjective_iff_auxiliaryMultiply_injective
statement:
theorem operatorDifferential_surjective_iff_auxiliaryMultiply_injective
    [Finite J] [CharZero K] (g : J → ℤ) (r : ℤ)
    (T : Fin 3 → positiveGrade (K := K) g r →ₗ[K] positiveGrade (K := K) g (r + 1))
    (L : Fin 3 → negativeGrade (K := K) g (r + 1) →ₗ[K] negativeGrade (K := K) g r)
    (h : ∀ i q p, residuePair g (r + 1) q (T i p) = residuePair g r (L i q) p)
    (t : ℕ) :
    Function.Surjective (operatorDifferential (K := K) (V := positiveGrade (K := K) g r) (W := positiveGrade (K := K) g (r + 1)) T t) ↔
      Function.Injective (auxiliaryOperatorMultiply (K := K) (W' := negativeGrade (K := K) g (r + 1)) (V' := negativeGrade (K := K) g r) L t)

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.algebraMap_X_monomial_coeff
statement:
theorem algebraMap_X_monomial_coeff (s b : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) (i : Fin 3) :
    algebraMap K R ((X i * monomial s 1 : Poly K 3).coeff b) =
      (X i * monomial s 1 : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) R).coeff b

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.algebraMap_pderiv_monomial_coeff
statement:
theorem algebraMap_pderiv_monomial_coeff (s b : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) (i : Fin 3) :
    algebraMap K R ((pderiv i (monomial b 1 : Poly K 3)).coeff s) =
      (pderiv i (monomial b 1 : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) R)).coeff s

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.finiteMultiply_eq_auxiliaryOperatorMultiply
statement:
theorem finiteMultiply_eq_auxiliaryOperatorMultiply (f : Fin 3 → R) (t : ℕ)
    (q : Sym (Fin 3) t → M) :
    finiteMultiply f t q = auxiliaryOperatorMultiply (fun i => scalarAction (K := K) (f i)) t q

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.finiteMultiply_monomial_coefficients
statement:
theorem finiteMultiply_monomial_coefficients (f : Fin 3 → R) (t : ℕ)
    (q : Sym (Fin 3) t → M) (b : Sym (Fin 3) (t + 1)) :
    finiteMultiply f t q b = ∑ s : Sym (Fin 3) t, ∑ i : Fin 3,
      (X i * monomial (homogeneousTensorExponent t s) 1 : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) R).coeff
        (homogeneousTensorExponent (t + 1) b) • (f i • q s)

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.scalarAction_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem scalarAction_apply (a : R) (m : M) : scalarAction (K := K) a m = a • m

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.auxiliaryOperatorMultiply_project
statement:
theorem auxiliaryOperatorMultiply_project (T : Fin 3 → V →ₗ[K] W)
    (ι : P →ₗ[K] V) (ρ : W →ₗ[K] Q) (t : ℕ) (p : Sym (Fin 3) t → P) :
    auxiliaryOperatorMultiply (fun i => ρ.comp ((T i).comp ι)) t p =
      fun s => ρ (auxiliaryOperatorMultiply T t (fun b => ι (p b)) s)

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.finiteMultiply_project
statement:
theorem finiteMultiply_project (f : Fin 3 → R) (ι : P →ₗ[K] M) (ρ : M →ₗ[K] Q)
    (t : ℕ) (p : Sym (Fin 3) t → P) :
    auxiliaryOperatorMultiply (fun i => ρ.comp ((scalarAction (K := K) (f i)).comp ι)) t p =
      fun s => ρ (finiteMultiply f t (fun b => ι (p b)) s)

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.operatorDifferential_project
statement:
theorem operatorDifferential_project (T : Fin 3 → V →ₗ[K] W)
    (ι : P →ₗ[K] V) (ρ : W →ₗ[K] Q) (t : ℕ) (p : Sym (Fin 3) (t + 1) → P) :
    operatorDifferential (fun i => ρ.comp ((T i).comp ι)) t p =
      fun s => ρ (operatorDifferential T t (fun b => ι (p b)) s)

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.vectorResidueFunctional_basis_free
statement:
theorem vectorResidueFunctional_basis_free [Finite ι] (g : ι → ℤ) (r : ℤ)
    (w : ι → K) (q : FreeLaurent K ι) (e : PositiveIndex g r) :
    vectorResidueFunctional w (freeLaurentEquiv q)
      (freeLaurentEquiv (positiveBasis g r e).val) =
      w e.val.1 * q (complementIndex g r e).val

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.vectorResidueFunctional_componentNegativePart
statement:
theorem vectorResidueFunctional_componentNegativePart [Finite ι]
    (g : ι → ℤ) (r : ℤ) (w : ι → K) (q : ι → BinaryLaurent K)
    (p : positiveGrade (K := K) g r) :
    vectorResidueFunctional w (fun i => negativePart (q i)) (freeLaurentEquiv p.val) =
      vectorResidueFunctional w q (freeLaurentEquiv p.val)

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.vectorResidueFunctional_freeNegativePart
statement:
theorem vectorResidueFunctional_freeNegativePart [Finite ι]
    (g : ι → ℤ) (r : ℤ) (w : ι → K) (q : FreeLaurent K ι)
    (p : positiveGrade (K := K) g r) :
    vectorResidueFunctional w (freeLaurentEquiv (freeNegativePart q)) (freeLaurentEquiv p.val) =
      vectorResidueFunctional w (freeLaurentEquiv q) (freeLaurentEquiv p.val)

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.vectorResidueFunctional_projected_cyclic_transpose
statement:
theorem vectorResidueFunctional_projected_cyclic_transpose
    (g : Fin 3 → ℤ) (r : ℤ) (c : K) (γ q : Fin 3 → BinaryLaurent K)
    (p : positiveGrade (K := K) g r) :
    vectorResidueFunctional (fun _ : Fin 3 => c) q (QWeyl.cyclicZ γ (freeLaurentEquiv p.val)) =
      vectorResidueFunctional (fun _ : Fin 3 => c)
        (fun i => negativePart (QWeyl.cyclicZDual γ q i)) (freeLaurentEquiv p.val)

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentChartComplex.ker_topAuxiliaryResidueMap
statement:
theorem ker_topAuxiliaryResidueMap [Finite J] [CharZero K]
    (g : J → ℤ) (r : ℤ) (t : ℕ) :
    LinearMap.ker (topAuxiliaryResidueMap (K := K) g r t) =
      LinearMap.range (chartDifference (K := K)
        (fun i : J × Sym (Fin 3) t => 2 - g i.1) (-r))

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentChartComplex.topAuxiliaryResidueMap_surjective
statement:
theorem topAuxiliaryResidueMap_surjective [Finite J] [CharZero K]
    (g : J → ℤ) (r : ℤ) (t : ℕ) :
    Function.Surjective (topAuxiliaryResidueMap (K := K) g r t)

name: ChoppedPlane.genericChoppedConclusion_nonpositive
statement:
theorem genericChoppedConclusion_nonpositive
    (d p : ℕ) (hd : 2 ≤ d) (hlo : N (d - 1) < p) (hhi : p < N d)
    (hr : 3 ≤ N d - p) (ha : aCount d (N d - p) ≤ 0) :
    GenericChoppedConclusion K d p

name: ChoppedPlane.choppedIdeal_eq_singleton_of_space_eq
statement:
theorem choppedIdeal_eq_singleton_of_space_eq (a : PointCoordinates K p)
    (f : Forms K 3 d)
    (hspan : pointDegreeSpace K a d = Submodule.span K {f.val}) :
    choppedIdeal K a d = Ideal.span {f.val}

name: ChoppedPlane.exists_principal_pointDegreeSpace
statement:
theorem exists_principal_pointDegreeSpace (a : PointCoordinates K p)
    (hdim : finrank K (pointDegreePiece K a d) = 1) :
    ∃ f : Forms K 3 d, f.val ≠ 0 ∧
      pointDegreeSpace K a d = Submodule.span K {f.val}

name: ChoppedPlane.nonzero_form_regular_singleton
statement:
theorem nonzero_form_regular_singleton (f : Forms K 3 d) (hf : f.val ≠ 0)
    (hd : 0 < d) : RingTheory.Sequence.IsRegular (Poly K 3) [f.val]

name: ChoppedPlane.principal_chop_conclusion
statement:
theorem principal_chop_conclusion (a : PointCoordinates K p) (hd : 0 < d)
    (hdim : finrank K (pointDegreePiece K a d) = 1) :
    ∃ f : Forms K 3 d,
      f.val ≠ 0 ∧
      pointDegreeSpace K a d = Submodule.span K {f.val} ∧
      choppedIdeal K a d = Ideal.span {f.val} ∧
      RingTheory.Sequence.IsRegular (Poly K 3) [f.val] ∧
      ∀ t : ℕ, (choppedHilbertFunction a d t : ℤ) = N₂ t - N₂ ((t : ℤ) - d)

name: ChoppedPlane.principal_chop_hilbert_coefficients
statement:
theorem principal_chop_hilbert_coefficients (a : PointCoordinates K p)
    (f : Forms K 3 d) (hf : f.val ≠ 0)
    (hspan : pointDegreeSpace K a d = Submodule.span K {f.val}) (t : ℕ) :
    (choppedHilbertFunction a d t : ℤ) = N₂ t - N₂ ((t : ℤ) - d)

name: ChoppedPlane.principal_chop_hilbert_coefficients_nat
statement:
theorem principal_chop_hilbert_coefficients_nat (a : PointCoordinates K p)
    (f : Forms K 3 d) (hf : f.val ≠ 0)
    (hspan : pointDegreeSpace K a d = Submodule.span K {f.val}) (t : ℕ) :
    choppedHilbertFunction a d t = (N₂ t - N₂ ((t : ℤ) - d)).toNat

name: ChoppedPlane.principal_chop_regular_generators
statement:
theorem principal_chop_regular_generators (a : PointCoordinates K p) (hd : 0 < d)
    (hdim : finrank K (pointDegreePiece K a d) = 1) :
    ∃ f : Fin 1 → Forms K 3 d,
      Ideal.span (Set.range (fun i => (f i).val)) = choppedIdeal K a d ∧
      RingTheory.Sequence.IsRegular (Poly K 3) (List.ofFn (fun i => (f i).val))

name: ChoppedPlane.genericChoppedConclusion_one_generator
statement:
theorem genericChoppedConclusion_one_generator [CharZero K]
    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (_hp : 1 ≤ p) (hlo : N (d - 1) < p) (hhi : p < N d)
    (hr : N d - p = 1) : GenericChoppedConclusion K d p

name: ChoppedPlane.mainConclusion_one_generator
statement:
theorem mainConclusion_one_generator (a : PointCoordinates K p)
    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hlo : N (d - 1) < p) (hhi : p < N d)
    (hr : N d - p = 1) (hdist : DistinctPoints K a)
    (hpoint : ∀ t, pointHilbertFunction K a t = min (N t) p) :
    MainConclusion K a d

name: ChoppedPlane.operatorDifferential_equiv_apply
statement:
theorem operatorDifferential_equiv_apply
    (E : V ≃ₗ[K] V') (F : W ≃ₗ[K] W')
    (T : Fin 3 → V →ₗ[K] W) (T' : Fin 3 → V' →ₗ[K] W')
    (h : ∀ i v, F (T i v) = T' i (E v)) (t : ℕ)
    (c : Sym (Fin 3) (t+1) → V) :
    (fun s => F (operatorDifferential T t c s)) =
      operatorDifferential T' t (fun s => E (c s))

name: ChoppedPlane.operatorDifferential_surjective_iff_of_equiv
statement:
theorem operatorDifferential_surjective_iff_of_equiv
    (E : V ≃ₗ[K] V') (F : W ≃ₗ[K] W')
    (T : Fin 3 → V →ₗ[K] W) (T' : Fin 3 → V' →ₗ[K] W')
    (h : ∀ i v, F (T i v) = T' i (E v)) (t : ℕ) :
    Function.Surjective (operatorDifferential T t) ↔
      Function.Surjective (operatorDifferential T' t)

name: ChoppedPlane.positiveLinearBlock_lift
statement:
@[simp] theorem positiveLinearBlock_lift {r a : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (L : LinearMatrix K a (positiveRowColumns r a)) :
    positiveLinearBlock hr (positiveRowLift hr L) = L

name: ChoppedPlane.positiveLinearBlock_surjective
statement:
theorem positiveLinearBlock_surjective {r a : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    Function.Surjective (positiveLinearBlock (K := K) (a := a) hr)

name: ChoppedPlane.positiveLinearBlock_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem positiveLinearBlock_val {r a : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (B : HomogeneousRowMatrix K (positiveRowProfile r a))
    (i : Fin a) (j : Fin (positiveRowColumns r a)) :
    (positiveLinearBlock hr B i j).val = (B (positiveLinearRowIndex hr i) j).val

name: ChoppedPlane.positiveLinearRowIndex_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem positiveLinearRowIndex_val {r a : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (i : Fin a) :
    (positiveLinearRowIndex hr i).val = r + i.val

name: ChoppedPlane.positiveRowColumns_rows
statement:
theorem positiveRowColumns_rows (r a : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r) :
    positiveRowColumns r a + 1 = r + a

name: ChoppedPlane.positiveRowProfile_function_sum
statement:
theorem positiveRowProfile_function_sum (r a : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r) (g : ℕ → ℤ) :
    (∑ i, g (positiveRowProfile r a i)) = (r : ℤ) * g 2 + (a : ℤ) * g 1

name: ChoppedPlane.positiveRowProfile_linear
statement:
@[simp] theorem positiveRowProfile_linear {r a : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (i : Fin a) :
    positiveRowProfile r a (positiveLinearRowIndex hr i) = 1

name: ChoppedPlane.positiveRowProfile_sum
statement:
theorem positiveRowProfile_sum (r a : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r) :
    (∑ i, positiveRowProfile r a i) = 2 * r + a

name: ChoppedPlane.positiveRow_counts
statement:
theorem positiveRow_counts {r a : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    aCount (positiveRowGeneratorDegree r a) r = a ∧
      cCount (positiveRowGeneratorDegree r a) r = positiveRowColumns r a

name: ChoppedPlane.positiveRow_linearBlock_allTwists_open
statement:
theorem positiveRow_linearBlock_allTwists_open {r a : ℕ} (hr : 2 ≤ r)
    (hw : ∃ L : LinearMatrix K a (positiveRowColumns r a),
      ∀ t, LinearMatrixMaximalRank L t) :
    ∃ D : MvPolynomial (RowMatrixParameter (positiveRowProfile r a)) K,
      (∃ u, eval u D ≠ 0) ∧
      ∀ u, eval u D ≠ 0 → ∀ t,
        LinearMatrixMaximalRank (universalPositiveLinearBlock (by omega : 0 < r) u) t

name: ChoppedPlane.positiveRow_minorHilbertFunction
statement:
theorem positiveRow_minorHilbertFunction
    {r a : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (B : HomogeneousRowMatrix K (positiveRowProfile r a))
    (hprimitive : PrimitiveMaximalMinors (rowMatrixVal (positiveRowProfile r a) B))
    (t : ℤ) :
    (minorHilbertFunction (rowMatrixVal (positiveRowProfile r a) B) t : ℤ) =
      hbCoefficient (positiveRowGeneratorDegree r a) r t

name: ChoppedPlane.positiveRow_minorHilbertFunction_formula
statement:
theorem positiveRow_minorHilbertFunction_formula
    {r a : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (B : HomogeneousRowMatrix K (positiveRowProfile r a))
    (hprimitive : PrimitiveMaximalMinors (rowMatrixVal (positiveRowProfile r a) B))
    (t : ℤ) :
    (minorHilbertFunction (rowMatrixVal (positiveRowProfile r a) B) t : ℤ) =

theorem positiveRow_exists_point_matrix_witness [Infinite K] [IsAlgClosed K]
    {r a : ℕ} (hr : 2 ≤ r)
    (hw : ∃ M : LinearMatrix K a (positiveRowColumns r a),
      ∀ t, LinearMatrixMaximalRank M t) :
    ∃ (B : HomogeneousRowMatrix K (positiveRowProfile r a))
      (z : PointCoordinates K (N (positiveRowGeneratorDegree r a) - r)),
      PrimitiveMaximalMinors
        (rowMatrixVal (positiveRowProfile r a) B) ∧
      DistinctPoints K z ∧
      (∀ t, pointDegreePiece K z t = idealFormPiece
        (maximalMinorIdeal
          (rowMatrixVal (positiveRowProfile r a) B)) t) ∧
      (∀ t, LinearMatrixMaximalRank
        (positiveLinearBlock (by omega : 0 < r) B) t) ∧
      Function.Surjective (pointEvaluation K z (positiveRowGeneratorDegree r a)) ∧
      ∀ e, pointHilbertFunction K z (positiveRowGeneratorDegree r a + e) =
        N (positiveRowGeneratorDegree r a) - r

    (hw : ∃ M : LinearMatrix K a (positiveRowColumns r a),
      ∀ t, LinearMatrixMaximalRank M t) :
    ∃ D : MvPolynomial (RowMatrixParameter (positiveRowProfile r a)) K,
      (∃ u, eval u D ≠ 0) ∧ ∀ u, eval u D ≠ 0 →
        PrimitiveMaximalMinors
          (rowMatrixVal (positiveRowProfile r a) (universalRowMatrix _ u)) ∧
        ∃ z : PointCoordinates K (N (positiveRowGeneratorDegree r a) - r),
          DistinctPoints K z ∧
          (∀ t, pointDegreePiece K z t = idealFormPiece
            (maximalMinorIdeal
              (rowMatrixVal (positiveRowProfile r a) (universalRowMatrix _ u))) t) ∧
          (∀ t, LinearMatrixMaximalRank
            (universalPositiveLinearBlock (by omega : 0 < r) u) t) ∧
          Function.Surjective (pointEvaluation K z (positiveRowGeneratorDegree r a)) ∧
          ∀ e, pointHilbertFunction K z (positiveRowGeneratorDegree r a + e) =
            N (positiveRowGeneratorDegree r a) - r

name: ChoppedPlane.finrank_choppedQuotient
statement:
theorem finrank_choppedQuotient [FiniteDimensional K W]
    (A : E →ₗ[K] V × W) (φ : V × W →ₗ[K] M)
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective φ)
    (hexact : LinearMap.ker φ = LinearMap.range A) :
    Module.finrank K (M ⧸ choppedSubmodule φ) =
      Module.finrank K W -
        Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range ((LinearMap.snd K V W).comp A))

name: ChoppedPlane.finrank_choppedQuotient_of_maximalRank

theorem finrank_choppedQuotient_of_maximalRank
    [FiniteDimensional K E] [FiniteDimensional K W]
    (A : E →ₗ[K] V × W) (φ : V × W →ₗ[K] M)
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective φ)
    (hexact : LinearMap.ker φ = LinearMap.range A)
    (hmax : Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range ((LinearMap.snd K V W).comp A)) =
      min (Module.finrank K E) (Module.finrank K W)) :
    Module.finrank K (M ⧸ choppedSubmodule φ) =
      Module.finrank K W - Module.finrank K E

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.cyclicActionHom_scaledBaseChange
statement:
theorem cyclicActionHom_scaledBaseChange
    (φ : A →+* A') (F : A) (F' H : A') (hF : φ F = F' * H ^ 3)
    (T : (Fin 3 → A) →ₛₗ[φ] (Fin 3 → A'))
    (Z : Module.End A (Fin 3 → A)) (Z' : Module.End A' (Fin 3 → A'))
    (hZ : Z ^ 3 = F • 1) (hZ' : Z' ^ 3 = F' • 1)
    (hT : ∀ m, T (Z m) = H • Z' (T m))
    (r : CyclicCubicRing A F) (m : Fin 3 → A) :
    T (cyclicActionHom F Z hZ r m) =
      cyclicActionHom F' Z' hZ' (cyclicScaledBaseChangeHom φ F F' H hF r) (T m)

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.cyclicActionHom_scaledBaseChange_polynomial
statement:
theorem cyclicActionHom_scaledBaseChange_polynomial
    (φ : A →+* A') (F : A) (F' H : A') (hF : φ F = F' * H ^ 3)
    (Z' : Module.End A' (Fin 3 → A')) (hZ' : Z' ^ 3 = F' • 1)
    (p : Polynomial A) :
    cyclicActionHom F' Z' hZ'
      (cyclicScaledBaseChangeHom φ F F' H hF
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {cyclicCubicEquation F}) p)) =
      Polynomial.aeval (H • Z') (p.map φ)

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.cyclicModuleScaledBaseChange_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem cyclicModuleScaledBaseChange_apply
    (φ : A →+* A') (F : A) (F' H : A') (hF : φ F = F' * H ^ 3)
    (T : (Fin 3 → A) →ₛₗ[φ] (Fin 3 → A'))
    (Z : Module.End A (Fin 3 → A)) (Z' : Module.End A' (Fin 3 → A'))
    (hZ : Z ^ 3 = F • 1) (hZ' : Z' ^ 3 = F' • 1)
    (hT : ∀ m, T (Z m) = H • Z' (T m)) (m : Fin 3 → A) :
    cyclicModuleScaledBaseChange φ F F' H hF T Z Z' hZ hZ' hT m = T m

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.cyclicScaledBaseChangeHom_coefficient
statement:
@[simp] theorem cyclicScaledBaseChangeHom_coefficient
    (φ : A →+* A') (F : A) (F' H : A') (hF : φ F = F' * H ^ 3) (a : A) :
    cyclicScaledBaseChangeHom φ F F' H hF (cyclicCoefficientHom F a) =

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.cyclicScaledBaseChangeHom_root

      cyclicCoefficientHom F' H * cyclicRoot F'

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.profileDualPullbackWeights_intertwine
statement:
theorem profileDualPullbackWeights_intertwine (u v q : A) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0)

    cyclicProfileCoefficients (quarticU u v) (quarticV u v) q s i *

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.weightedVectorBaseChange_cyclicZ

theorem weightedVectorBaseChange_cyclicZ
    (φ : A →+* A') (γ : Fin 3 → A) (γ' ρ : Fin 3 → A') (H : A')

      WeightedVector w (t + 1) (Z m)) (n : ℕ) (j : Fin (n + 1))
    (α : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) (i k : Fin 3) :
    tensorCoefficients
      ((linearForm (quadraticOne (cyclicCoefficientHom F (binaryU K))
          (cyclicCoefficientHom F (binaryV K)) (cyclicRoot F)) ^ (j : ℕ) *
        linearForm (quadraticTwo (cyclicCoefficientHom F (binaryU K))
          (cyclicCoefficientHom F (binaryV K)) (cyclicRoot F)) ^ (n - j)) ⊗ₜ[CyclicCubicRing (BinaryRing K) F]
          (Pi.single k (1 : BinaryRing K) : BinaryVector K)) α i ∈
      signedForms K 2 (2 * n + w k - w i)

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.cubic_scalar_free_expansion
statement:
theorem cubic_scalar_free_expansion :
    let := cyclicModuleStructure F Z hZ
    ∀ (r : Cubic) (m : BinaryVector K) (i : Fin 3),
      (r • m) i = ∑ k : Fin 3, (r • (Pi.single k 1 : BinaryVector K)) i * m k

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.symmetric_kernel_zero_of_weighted_columns
statement:
theorem symmetric_kernel_zero_of_weighted_columns :
    let := cyclicModuleStructure F Z hZ
    ∀ (w : Fin 3 → ℕ) (t : ℤ) (n : ℕ)
    (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) Cubic)
    (_hcolumn : ∀ (j : Fin (n + 1)) (k : Fin 3) (α : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) (i : Fin 3),
      tensorCoefficients
        ((linearForm (A 1) ^ j.val * linearForm (A 2) ^ (n - j.val)) ⊗ₜ[Cubic]
          (Pi.single k 1 : BinaryVector K)) α i ∈
        signedForms K 2 (2 * (n : ℤ) + (w k : ℤ) - w i))
    (_ht : ∀ k : Fin 3, t < 2 * (n : ℤ) + (w k : ℤ))
    (P : AuxTensor (R := Cubic) (M := BinaryVector K))
    (_hP : ∀ (α : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) (i : Fin 3),
      tensorCoefficients P α i ∈ signedForms K 2 (t - w i))
    (c : Fin (n + 1) → BinaryVector K), kernelSynthesis A n c = P → P = 0

name: ChoppedPlane.exists_two_generator_witness
statement:
theorem exists_two_generator_witness [CharZero K] (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) :
    ∃ (a : PointCoordinates K ((d + 2).choose 2 - 2)) (q : Fin 2 → Forms K 3 d),
      pointDegreePiece K a d = Submodule.span K (Set.range q) ∧
      LinearIndependent K q ∧ (q 0).val ≠ 0 ∧ IsRelPrime (q 0).val (q 1).val

    (hd : 2 ≤ d) (_hp : 1 ≤ p) (hlo : N (d - 1) < p) (hhi : p < N d)
    (hr : N d - p = 2) : GenericChoppedConclusion K d p

name: ChoppedPlane.mainConclusion_two_generator
statement:
theorem mainConclusion_two_generator (a : PointCoordinates K p)
    (hd : 2 ≤ d) (hlo : N (d - 1) < p) (hhi : p < N d) (hr : N d - p = 2)
    (hdist : DistinctPoints K a)
    (hpoint : ∀ t, pointHilbertFunction K a t = min (N t) p)
    (q : Fin 2 → Forms K 3 d) (hspace : generatorSpace q = pointDegreeSpace K a d)
    (hq : (q 0).val ≠ 0) (hcop : IsRelPrime (q 0).val (q 1).val) :
    MainConclusion K a d

name: ChoppedPlane.regular_pair_point_principal_open
statement:
theorem regular_pair_point_principal_open [CharZero K] (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) :
    ∃ D : MvPolynomial (Fin ((d + 2).choose 2 - 2) × Fin 2) K,
      (∃ a, eval a D ≠ 0) ∧ ∀ a, eval a D ≠ 0 →
      ∃ q : Fin 2 → Forms K 3 d,
        generatorSpace q = pointDegreeSpace K a d ∧ (q 0).val ≠ 0 ∧
          IsRelPrime (q 0).val (q 1).val

name: ChoppedPlane.odd_block_row_budget
statement:
theorem odd_block_row_budget (a k m : ℕ)
    (hlow : (2*k+3)*m ≤ 2*a) (hhigh : 2*a < (2*k+3)*(m+1)) :
    ∃ A r : ℕ, r ≤ k ∧ a = A + (k*m+r) ∧
      3*m ≤ 2*A ∧ 2*A ≤ 3*(m+1)
